body.input: Would you travel to space? Be free. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Yeah, that's what I'm saying. I'd love to go into space, but not just to be a tourist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: I want to take science experiment in space and do a thing in space that had never been done before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: That's a real possibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Yeah. Yeah. So that's why there's no point in listing things I can't do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: All right. What small act of kindness were you once shown that you will never forget?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Small act of kindness, not big. Somebody was just kind to you. Somebody did something sweet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: When I was a PhD student, someone helped me out with just, I was basically, I needed a computer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: I needed some power, computation power, and someone took pity on me and helped me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: And gave me, I was really touched. They didn't have to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: And they were actually quite, they were disabled scientists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: They had other things to do rather than help some random PhD student.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Gave me access, taught me a lot of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Yeah. Actually, when you're a grad student or when you're a student, when you're even a student,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: the younger it is, the better. The attention, the support, the love you get from an older person,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: the teacher, something like that is super powerful. It's fascinating. And from the

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: perspective of the teacher, they might not realize the impact they have, but that little bit,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: those few words, a little bit of help can have a lot of impact. What about you, Sarah?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Somebody give you a free Starbucks at some point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: I love free Starbucks. I like it when you're in the line at Starbucks and somebody buys your

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: coffee in front of you and then you buy the next one. I love those, but that's not my example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: I love that too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Those are great. It makes me happy. And now my kids get all excited when we do it, when we go in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: We're the first ones in line doing it. I guess I can use a similar example about just being a

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: student. Paul Davies is a very well known theoretical physicist and he was generous enough

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: with his time to take me on as a postdoc. But before I became his postdoc, he invited me to

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: a workshop at Arizona State University and the Beyond Center and took a walk with me around campus

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: just to talk about ideas after. And I think there were two things that were completely generous about

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: that. One is Paul's philosophy is always interacting with young people. It's like you

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: interact with a mind in the room. It doesn't matter how well known or whatever. It's like you

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: evaluate the person for the person. But he also gave me a book, The Eerie Silence that he had

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: written and he wrote in it. This is how EE gets to ET, which was an antimeric excess, which I worked

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: on as a PhD student. It was the origin of homo chirality all the way up to what the book was about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: which was, are we alone in the universe and is there intelligent life out there? And it was just

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: so much about the questions I wanted to ask because it was just everything about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: it was just really, really kind. Like that it's okay to ask these questions?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Yeah. And you can actually have strong enough to answer them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: I think a lot of my career is mostly his encouragement to ask deep questions. He gave me

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: the space to do it in ways that a lot of previous mentors had. I've had a good experience with

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: mentors, but it was like go off the deep end, ask the hardest questions. And I think that's the best

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: gift you can give somebody. What would you, because you're both fascinating minds and not,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: I would say non-standard in the best possible way. Is there advice you can give to young folks how

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: to be non-standard, how to stand out, novelty, how to generate novelty?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: That's what I want on my tombstone. I have one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: He generated novelty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: No, no, how to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Oh, how to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Still. I just love doing science. And so when I was younger, I was just wanted to, I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: I'm still not sure I'm a real scientist, right? So I want to try. So my advice for the young people

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: is just, if you love asking questions, then don't be afraid to ask the question, even if it pisses

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: people off. Because if you piss people off, you're probably asking the right question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: What I would say though is don't do what I did, which is just piss everyone off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Try and work out how to, I think, if other people are challenged by your questions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: you will get not only respect, but people will give you, create space for you because you're

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: doing something really new. I really try to create space in my academic career, my team,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: really try and praise them and push them to do new things. So my advice is try to do new things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: get feedback, and the universe will help you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Because the universe likes novelty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Because the universe likes novelty. I think so. I think so, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: This one will keep them around. What about you, Sarah? You too like to ask the really

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: out there big questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Yeah, because I have a strong passion for them. So I think it goes back to the love. If you're

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: doing the thing you're supposed to be doing, you should really love it. So I always tell people

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: that they should do the thing they're most passionate about. But I think a flip side of

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: that is that's when you become, in some way, not to sound cheesy, but your best version of yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: So I guess for me, as I become more successful in my career, I feel like I can be more myself

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: as an individual. And so there's this, I've always been following the questions I'm most interested

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: in, which very early on I was discouraged from knowing by many people because they thought they

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: were unanswerable questions. And I always just thought, well, if no one's even trying to answer

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: them, of course they're going to be unanswerable. And then that was kind of an odd viewpoint. But

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: the more I found my way in that space, the more I also made a space for myself as a person, because

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: you're basically generating the niche that you want to exist in. And so I think that's part of

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: it is not just to follow your passion, but also think about who do you want to be and create that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Yeah. Who am I? Who do you want to be? I mean, yeah, play temporally with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Yeah. Who am I now? Who do I want to be now? But who do I want to be in the future? They're not

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: decoupled. Yeah. I always wonder if that's like, if I become something, am I finding myself or am I

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: creating myself? And I think those are somehow the same kind of thing. I do feel often like I was

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: always meant to be this kind of thing. But is that created or discovered? I don't know, but basically

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: go towards that direction. If you were abducted by aliens, Sarah. Excellent. I'm waiting. They can come find me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: They're on a spaceship. And then they somehow figured out the language you speak

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: and ask you, what are you? Explain yourself. Not you, Sarah, but the species.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Oh, what's life on earth? Like we don't have time or busy grad students from another planet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: I see. What's interesting about human civilization? What's interesting about you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: You specifically too, they could be very kind of personal, kind of pushy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: How would you describe? Okay. I have one. Because obviously I self identify as a scientist and a

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: physicist, but intrinsically I feel more like an artist. But it's almost like you're an artist that

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: you don't know what you're painting yet. And I guess I feel like that's humanity. In some sense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: we're creating something I think is profound and potentially very beautiful in existence in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: universe. But we're just early. We're young. We don't know what we're doing yet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Yeah. What's with the nuclear weapons? That'd be a question too. What are you guys?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: What are we doing with them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: This creativity that you talk about sounds very nice, but it's...

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: We're making things that are...

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Very destructive and the rockets, this seems very aggressive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Yeah. I know. This is my blinders on. I don't know. It goes back to the whole conversation

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: about suffering. I have a hard time regularizing certain aspects of reality into what I want to

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: envision. And that's obviously problematic, but nuclear power has also given us a lot of good things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: That's human nature. Both human beings and the technology we create has the capacity for evil

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: and the capacity for good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Yeah. And we can't all be good all the time. There's this huge misnomer that you need to be

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: liked by everyone universally. And obviously that's an ideal, but it's physically impossible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: You can't get a group of people in a room and have everyone like each other all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: So I think that kind of tension is actually really important that we have different aesthetics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: different goals, and sometimes conflict comes out of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Speaking of which, do you Lee and Yoshua Bach ever say anything nice to each other or is it always conflict?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: We never have conflict. We argue, but I don't think they argue arguments are bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: It's a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: I think the problem I have... Not problem, I think...

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Here we go. He's not here to defend himself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: I don't necessarily understand the... I mean, he's just talking at such a high level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: I'm a dimwit. So I think a lot of our conflict is not conflict.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: I mean, I can't speak for Yoshua. I have a deep appreciation for him. He's brilliant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: But I think I'm kind of frustrated and I'm trying to...

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: He thinks the universe is a computer and I want to turn the universe into a computer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Yeah. That's a small disagreement. So how would you defend your life to an alien

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: when you're being abducted? Would you focus on the specifics of your life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: No, no, no. I would try and be as random as possible and try and confuse them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Oh, good. Good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Excellent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: That might be the wiser choice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: The Easter eggs in reality?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: No, I mean, if aliens abducted me...

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Would you play dumb?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: No, no. I would try and be as random as... I would try and do something that would surprise

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: the hell out of them, which I thought... I mean, it's probably quite risky. They might kill me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: but I think that would probably be funny.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Yeah. They might want to study you for prolonged periods of time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: My reasoning is if I wanted to stay alive, okay, so if the thing is, if I wasn't going

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: back to Earth and the job was to stay alive, if I could be as surprising as possible,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: they'd keep me around like a pet, right? Petly on the alien space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: So you'd be okay being a pet?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Well, no, but I mean...

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: The last human that survives would just be a pet to the alien.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: I don't know, but I mean, I think that might be fun because then that might...

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: I might get some feedback from their curiosity, but yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Let me ask you this question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Given our conversation has a very different meaning, not a more profound meaning perhaps,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: but would you rather lose all of your old memories or never be able to make new ones?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: I would have to lose all my old memories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Again, it's the novelty. What about you, Sarah?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: I'm the same because I don't think... It's about the future experience, right? And in some sense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: like you were saying earlier, most of our lived experience is actually in our memories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: So if you can't generate new memories, it's like you're not alive anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: That's it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: What comforts you on bad days? When you look at human civilization, when you look at your own life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: what gives you hope? What makes you feel good about what we're doing, about life at the small

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: scale of you as a human and at the big scale of us as a human civilization, maybe the big scale of the universe?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Children, my kids. But I also mean that in a grand sense of like... Not a grand, but like future minds

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: in some sense. So for me, the most bleak movie ever, people worry about apocalyptic things like

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: AI existential risk and climate change, which children of men... The whole premise of the movie

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: was there can be no children born on the entire planet. And the youngest person on the planet is

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: like 18 years old or something. Can you imagine a world without children? It's just... It's harrowing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: That's the scariest thing. So I think what gives me hope is always youth and the hope of children

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: and the possibilities of the future they see. And they grow up in a completely different reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: And I think we have a hard time seeing what their reality actually looks like. But I think most of the time it's super interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Yeah, they have dreams, they have imagination, they have this kind of excitement. It's so cool. So fun to watch.

body.input: And yeah, you feel like you're almost getting in the way of all that imagination. What about you, Lee?

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: What gives you hope? So when I go back to my eight-year-old self, the thing that I dreamed of

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: as my eight-year-old self was this world in which technology became programmable. When there was

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: internet, I'd get information and I would expand my consciousness by just getting access to

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: everything that was going on. And this happened in my lifetime. I mean, really do have that. I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: okay, there's some bad things, there's TikTok, everyone just don't... Whatever, all the bad things

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: about social media. But I think... I mean, I can't quite believe my luck being born now. So amazing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Being able to program reality in some way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Yeah. And the thing that I really find fascinating about human beings is just how ingenious they are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Whether it's from my kids, my research group, my peers, other companies, just how ingenious everyone

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: is. And I'm pretty sure humanity has a... Or our causal chain in which humanity is a vital part in

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: the future is going to have a lot of fun. And I'm just... Yeah, it's just mind-blowing just to watch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: So humans are ingenious and I hope to help them be more ingenious if I can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Well, what gives me hope, what makes me feel good on bad days is the existence of wild minds like

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: yours, novelty generators, assembly structures that generate novelty and do so beautifully.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: And then tweet about it. Sarah, I really, really enjoy talking to you. I enjoy following you. I'm

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: a huge fan. Sarah Lee, I hope to talk to you many times in the future, maybe with Yosh Shabach. You're

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: just incredible people. Thank you for everything you do. You're awesome. Thank you for talking today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: I really, really appreciate it. Thanks. Yeah, brilliant to be here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: Thanks for listening to this conversation with Sarah Walker and Lee Cronin. To support this

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: podcast, please check out our sponsors in the description. And now let me leave you with some

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: words from Arthur C. Clarke. Two possibilities exist. Either we are alone in the universe or

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: we are not. Both are equally terrifying. And let me, if I may, add to that by saying that both

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: possibilities, at least to me, are both terrifying and exciting. And keeping these two feelings in

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: my heart is a fun way to explore, to wander, to think, and to live, always a little bit on the

metadata.title: Podcast: Alien Debate: Sara Walker and Lee Cronin | Lex Fridman Podcast #279

body.input: edge of madness. Thank you for listening. I hope to see you next time.
