metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It's a different flavor of what they're doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: They're much more in touch with the actual machine in a, but in a positive way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: That is you can talk about memory in a more controlled way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You can talk about the different data types that the machine supports and the way they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: and more ways to structure and organize data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And so the system programming languages, there was a lot of effort in that in the, call it

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: the late sixties, early seventies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: C is I think the only real survivor of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And then what happens after that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You get things like object oriented programming languages because as you write programs in

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: a language like C, at some point scale gets to you and it's too hard to keep track of

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: the pieces and there's no guard rails or training wheels or something like that to prevent you

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: from doing bad things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So C plus plus comes out of that tradition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And then it took off from there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I mean, there's also a parallel, slightly parallel track with a little bit of functional

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: stuff with Lisp and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: But I guess from that point it's just an explosion of languages.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: There's the Java story, there's the JavaScript, there's all the stuff that the cool kids these

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: days are doing with Rust and all that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So what's to you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You wrote a book, C programming language.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And C is probably one of the most important languages in the history of programming languages.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: If you kind of look at impact, what do you think is the most elegant or powerful part

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: of C?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Why did it survive?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Why did it have such a long lasting impact?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think it found a sweet spot of expressiveness, that you could rewrite things in a pretty

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: natural way and efficiency, which was particularly important when computers were not nearly as

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: powerful as they are today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You've got to put yourself back 50 years almost in terms of what computers could do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: That's roughly four or five generations, decades of Moore's law.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So expressiveness and efficiency and I don't know, perhaps the environment that it came

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: with as well, which was Unix.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So it meant if you wrote a program, it could be used on all those computers that ran Unix

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: and that was all of those computers because they were all written in C and that was Unix,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: the operating system itself was portable as were all the tools.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So it all worked together again in one of these things where things fed on each other

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: in a positive cycle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: What did it take to write sort of a definitive book, probably definitive book on all of programs?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It's more definitive to a particular language than any other book on any other language

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: and did two really powerful things, which is popularized the language, at least from

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: my perspective, maybe you can correct me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And second is created a standard of how this language is supposed to be used and applied.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So what did it take?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Did you have those kinds of ambitions in mind when working on that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Is this some kind of joke?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: No, of course not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It's an accident of timing, skill and just luck.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: A lot of it is, clearly timing was good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Now, Dennis and I wrote the book in 1977.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Dennis Ritchie.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And at that point, Unix was starting to spread.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I don't know how many there were, but it would be dozens to hundreds of Unix systems and

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: C was also available on other kinds of computers that had nothing to do with Unix.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And so the language had some potential and there were no other books on C and Bell Labs

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: was really the only source for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And Dennis of course was authoritative because it was his language and he had written the

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: reference manual, which is a marvelous example of how to write a reference manual.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Really, really very, very well done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So I twisted his arm until he agreed to write a book and then we wrote a book.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And the virtue or advantage at least, I guess, of going first is that then other people have

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: to follow you if they're going to do anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And I think it worked well because Dennis was a superb writer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I mean, he really, really did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And the reference manual in that book is his period.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I had nothing to do with that at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So just crystal clear prose and very, very well expressed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And then he and I, I wrote most of the expository material and then he and I sort of did the

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: usual ping ponging back and forth, refining it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: But I spent a lot of time trying to find examples that would sort of hang together and that

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: would tell people what they might need to know at about the right time that they should

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: be thinking about needing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And I'm not sure it completely succeeded, but it mostly worked out fairly well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: What do you think is the power of example?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I mean, you're the creator, at least one of the first people to do the Hello World program,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: which is like the example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: If aliens discover our civilization hundreds of years from now, it'll probably be Hello

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: World programs, just like a half broken robot communicating with them with the Hello World.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And that's a representative example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So what do you find powerful about examples?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think a good example will tell you how to do something and it will be representative

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: of, you might not want to do exactly that, but you will want to do something that's at

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: least in that same general vein.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And so a lot of the examples in the C book were picked for these very, very simple, straightforward

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: text processing problems that were typical of Unix.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I want to read input and write it out again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: There's a copy command.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I want to read input and do something to it and write it out again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: There's a grab.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And so that kind of find things that are representative of what people want to do and spell those

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: out so that they can then take those and see the core parts and modify them to their taste.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And I think that a lot of programming books that I don't look at programming books a tremendous

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: amount these days, but when I do, a lot of them don't do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: They don't give you examples that are both realistic and something you might want to

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Some of them are pure syntax.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Here's how you add three numbers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Well, come on, I could figure that out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Tell me how I would get those three numbers into the computer and how we would do something

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: useful with them and then how I put them back out again, neatly formatted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And especially if you follow that example, there is something magical of doing something

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: that feels useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And I think it's the attempt, it's absolutely not perfect, but the attempt in all cases

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: was to get something that was going to be either directly useful or would be very representative

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: of useful things that a programmer might want to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: But within that vein of fundamentally text processing, reading text, doing something,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: writing text.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So you've also written a book on Go language.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I have to admit, so I worked at Google for a while and I've never used Go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Thought you missed something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Well, I know I missed something for sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I mean, so Go and Rust are two languages that I hear spoken very highly of and I wish I

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: would like to try.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Well, there's a lot of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: There's Julia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: There's all these incredible modern languages.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: If you can comment before, or maybe comment on what do you find, where does Go sit in

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: this broad spectrum of languages?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And also, how do you yourself feel about this wide range of powerful, interesting languages

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: that you may never even get to try to explore because of time?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So I think, so Go first comes from that same Bell Labs tradition in part, not exclusively,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: but two of the three creators, Ken Thompson and Rob Pike.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So literally the people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, the people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And then with this very, very useful influence from the European school, in particular, the

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Claude Spier influence through Robert Griezmer, who was, I guess, a second generation down

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: student at ETH.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And so that's an interesting combination of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And so some ways, Go captures the good parts of C. It looks sort of like C. It's sometimes

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: characterized as C for the 21st century.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: On the surface, it looks very, very much like C. But at the same time, it has some interesting

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: data structuring capabilities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And then I think the part that I would say is particularly useful, and again, I'm not

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: a Go expert, in spite of co-authoring the book, about 90% of the work was done by Alan

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Donovan, my co-author, who is a Go expert.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: But Go provides a very nice model of concurrency.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It's basically the cooperating, communicating sequential processes that Tony Hoare set forth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I don't know, 40 plus years ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: The Go routines are, to my mind, a very natural way to talk about parallel computation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And in the few experiments I've done with them, they're easy to write and typically

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: it's going to work and very efficient as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So I think that's one place where Go stands out, that that model of parallel computation

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: is very, very easy and nice to work with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Just to comment on that, do you think C foresaw, or the early Unix days foresaw threads and

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: massively parallel computation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I would guess not really.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I mean, maybe it was seen, but not at the level where it was something you had to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: anything about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: For a long time, processors got faster and then processors stopped getting faster because

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: of things like power consumption and heat generation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And so what happened instead was that instead of processors getting faster, there started

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: to be more of them and that's where that parallel thread stuff comes in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So if you can comment on all the other languages, is it break your heart that you'll never get

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: to explore them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Or how do you feel about the full variety?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It's not break my heart, but I would love to be able to try more of these languages.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: The closest I've come is in a class that I often teach in the spring here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It's a programming class and I often give, I have one sort of small example that I will

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: write in as many languages as I possibly can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I've got it in 20 odd languages at this point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And that's so I do a minimal experiment with a language just to say, okay, I have this

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: trivial task, which I understand the task and it should, it takes 15 lines in Auk and

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: not much more in a variety of other languages.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So how big is it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: How fast does it run?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And what pain did I go through to learn how to do it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And that's like anic data, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It's very, very, very narrowly fulcrum.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Anic data, I like that term.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So yeah, but still it's a little sample because you get the, I think the hardest step of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: programming language is probably the first step, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So there you're taking the first step.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And so my experience with some languages is very positive, like Lua, a scripting language

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I had never used.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And I took my little program.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: The program is a trivial formatter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It just takes in lines of text of varying lengths and it puts them out in lines that

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: have no more than 60 characters on each line.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So think of it as just kind of the flow of process in a browser or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So it's very short program.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And in Lua, I downloaded Lua and in an hour I had it working, never having written Lua

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: in my life, just going with online documentation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I did the same thing in Scala, which you can think of as a flavor of Java, equally trivial.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I did it in Haskell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It took me several weeks, but it did run like a turtle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And I did it in Fortran 90 and it was painful, but it worked.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And I tried it in Rust and it took me several days to get it working because the model of

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: memory management was just a little unfamiliar to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And the problem I had with Rust, and it's back to what we were just talking about, I

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: couldn't find good consistent documentation on Rust.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Now this was several years ago and I'm sure things have stabilized, but at the time everything

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: in the Rust world seemed to be changing rapidly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And so you would find what looked like a working example and it wouldn't work with the version

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: of the language that I had.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So it took longer than it should have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Rust is a language I would like to get back to, but probably won't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think one of the issues, you have to have something you want to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: If you don't have something that is the right combination, if I want to do it and yet I

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: have enough disposable time, whatever, to make it worth learning a new language at the

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: same time, it's never going to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So what do you think about another language of JavaScript?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Well, let me just sort of comment on what I said.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: When I was brought up, JavaScript was seen as probably the ugliest language possible,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: and yet it's quite arguably, quite possibly taking over not just the front end and the

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: back end of the internet, but possibly in the future taking over everything because

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: they've now learned to make it very efficient.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So what do you think about this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, well, I think you captured it in a lot of ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: When it first came out, JavaScript was deemed to be fairly irregular and an ugly language

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: and certainly in the academy, if you said you were working on JavaScript, people would

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: ridicule you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It was just not fit for academics to work on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think a lot of that has evolved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: The language itself has evolved and certainly the technology of compiling it is fantastically

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: better than it was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And so in that sense, it's absolutely a viable solution on backends as well as the front

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: ends.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Used well, I think it's a pretty good language.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I've written a modest amount of it and I've played with JavaScript translators and things

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I'm not a real expert and it's hard to keep up even there with the new things that come

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: along with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So I don't know whether it will ever take over the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think not, but it's certainly an important language and worth knowing more about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I want you to get your comment on something which JavaScript and actually most languages,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Python, such a big part of the experience of programming with those languages includes

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: libraries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Sort of building on top of the code that other people have built.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think that's probably different from the experience that we just talked about from

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Unix and C-Days when you're building stuff from scratch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: What do you think about this world of essentially building up libraries on top of each other

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: and leveraging them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, that's a very perceptive kind of question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: One of the reasons programming was fun in the old days was that you were really building

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: it all yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: The number of libraries you had to deal with was quite small.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Maybe it was printf or the standard library or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: That is not the case today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: If you want to do something in, you mentioned Python and JavaScript and those are the two

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: fine examples.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You have to typically download a boatload of other stuff and you have no idea what you're

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: getting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Absolutely nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I've been doing some playing with machine learning over the last couple of days and

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: gee, something doesn't work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Well you pip install this and down comes another gazillion megabytes of something and you have

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: no idea what it was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: If you're lucky, it works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: If it doesn't work, you have no recourse.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: There's absolutely no way you could figure out which of these thousand different packages.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think it's worse in the NPM environment for JavaScript.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think there's less discipline, less control there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: There's aspects of not just not understanding how it works, but there's security issues,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: there's robustness issues.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You don't want to run a nuclear power plant using JavaScript essentially.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Probably not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Speaking to the variety of languages, do you think that variety is good or do you hope

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: think that over time we should converge towards one, two, three programming languages?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You mentioned to the Bell Lab days when people could sort of, the community of it and the

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: more languages you have, the more you separate the communities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: There's the Ruby community, there's the Python community, there's C++ community.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Do you hope that they'll unite one day to just one or two languages?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I certainly don't hope it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I'm not sure that that's right because I honestly don't think there is one language that will

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: suffice for all the programming needs of the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Are there too many at this point?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Well, arguably.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: But I think if you look at the distribution of how they are used, there's something called

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: a dozen languages that probably account for 95% of all programming at this point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: That doesn't seem unreasonable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And then there's another, well, 2000 languages that are still in use that nobody uses and

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: or at least don't use in any quantity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: But I think new languages are a good idea in many respects because they're often a chance

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: to explore an idea of how a language might help.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think that's one of the positive things about functional languages.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: For example, they're a particularly good place where people have explored ideas that at the

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: time didn't seem feasible, but ultimately have wound up as part of mainstream languages

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I mean, just go back as early as recursion and Lisp and then follow forward with functions

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: as first class citizens and pattern-based languages and gee, I don't know, closures

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: and just on and on and on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Lambda's interesting ideas that showed up first in, let's call it broadly, the functional

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: programming community and then find their way into mainstream languages.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, it's a playground for rebels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And so I think the languages in the playground themselves are probably not going to be the

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: mainstream at least for some while, but the ideas that come from there are invaluable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So let's go to something that when I found out recently, so I've known you've done a

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: million things, but one of the things I wasn't aware of that you had a role in Ample and

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: before you interrupt me by minimizing your role in it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Ample is for minimizing functions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, minimizing functions, right, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Can I just say that the elegance and abstraction power of Ample is incredible?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: When I first came to it about 10 years ago or so, can you describe what is the Ample

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: language?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So Ample is a language for mathematical programming, technical term, think of it as linear programming,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: but is setting up systems of linear equations that are of some sort of system of constraints

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: so that you have a bunch of things that have to be less than this, greater than that, whatever,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: and you're trying to find a set of values for some decision variables that will maximize

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: or minimize some objective function.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So it's a way of solving a particular kind of optimization problem, a very formal sort

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: of optimization problem, but one that's exceptionally useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And it specifies so there's objective function constraints and variables that become separate

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: from the data it operates on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So that kind of separation allows you to put on different hats.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: One put the hat of an optimization person and then put another hat of a data person

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: and dance back and forth and also separate the actual solvers, the optimization systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: that do the solving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Then you can have other people come to the table and then build their solvers, whether

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: it's linear or nonlinear, convex, non-convex, that kind of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So what is the, do you, maybe you can comment how you got into that world and what is the

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: beautiful or interesting idea to you from the world of optimization?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So I preface it by saying I'm absolutely not an expert on this and most of the important

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: work in Ample comes from my two partners in crime on that, Bob Forer, who was a professor

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: of, in the industrial engineering and management science department at Northwestern, and my

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: colleague at Bell Labs, Dave Gay, who was a numerical analyst and optimization person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So the deal is linear programming.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Preface this by saying-

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Let's stay with linear programming.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Linear programming is the simplest example of this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So linear programming is taught in school is that you have a big matrix, which is always

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: called A and you say AX is less than or equal to B. So B is a set of constraints, X is the

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: decision variables, and A is how the decision variables are combined to set up the various

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: constraints.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So A is a matrix and X and B are vectors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And then there's an objective function, which is just the sum of a bunch of Xs and some

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: coefficients on them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And that's the thing you want to optimize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: The problem is that in the real world, that matrix A is a very, very, very intricate,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: very large and very sparse matrix where the various components of the model are distributed

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: among the coefficients in a way that is totally unobvious to anybody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And so what you need is some way to express the original model, which you and I would

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: write, we'd write mathematics on the board, the sum of this is greater than the sum of

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: that kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So you need a language to write those kinds of constraints.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And Bob Forer for a long time had been interested in modeling languages, languages that made

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: it possible to do this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: There was a modeling language around called GAMS, the General Algebraic Modeling System,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: but it looked very much like FORTRAN, it was kind of clunky.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And so Bob spent a sabbatical year at Bell Labs in 1984 and he was in the office across

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: from me and it's always geography.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And he and Dave Gay and I started talking about this kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And he wanted to design a language that would make it so that you could take these algebraic

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: specifications, summation signs over sets, and that you would write on the board and

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: convert them into basically this A matrix.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And then pass that off to a solver, which is an entirely separate thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And so we talked about the design of the language.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I don't remember any of the details of this now, but it's kind of an obvious thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You're just writing out mathematical expressions in a FORTRAN-like, sorry, an algebraic, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: textual-like language.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And I wrote the first version of this AMPL program, my first C++ program.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And so I did that fairly quickly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: We wrote, it was 3,000 lines or something, so it wasn't very big, but it sort of showed

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: the feasibility of it that you could actually do something that was easy for people to specify

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: models and convert it into something that a solver could work with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: At the same time, as you say, the model and the data are separate things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So one model would then work with all kinds of different data in the same way that lots

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: of programs do the same thing, but with different data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So one of the really nice things is the specification of the models.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Human just kind of like, as you say, is human readable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Like I literally, I remember on stuff I worked, I would send it to colleagues that I'm pretty

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: sure never programmed in their life just to understand what the optimization problem is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think, how hard is it to convert that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You said there's a first prototype in C++ to convert that into something that could

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: actually be used by the solver.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It's not too bad because most of the solvers have some mechanism that lets them import

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: a model in a form.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It might be as simple as the matrix itself in just some representation, or if you're

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: doing things that are not linear programming, then there may be some mechanism that lets

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: you provide things like functions to be called or other constraints on the model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So all Ample does is to generate that kind of thing, and then solver deals with all the

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: hard work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And then when the solver comes back with numbers, Ample converts those back into your original

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: form so you know how much of each thing you should be buying or making or shipping or

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So we did that in 84, and I haven't had a lot to do with it since except that we wrote

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: a couple of versions of a book on it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Which is one of the greatest books I've ever written.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I love that book.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I don't know why.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It's an excellent book.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Bob Forer wrote most of it, and so it's really, really well done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: He must be a dynamite teacher.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And typeset in LaTeX.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: No, no, no.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Are you kidding?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I remember liking the typography, so I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: We did it with DRoff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I don't even know what that is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You're too young.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Oh boy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Think of DRoff as a predecessor to the tech family of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It's a formatter that was done at Bell Labs in this same period of the very early 70s

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: that predates tech and things like that by five to 10 years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: But it was nevertheless, I'm going by memories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I remember it being beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, it was nicely done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Instead of Unix, C, A, Golang, all the things we talked about, all the amazing work you've

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: done, you've also done work in graph theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Let me ask this crazy out there question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: If you had to make a bet, and I had to force you to make a bet, do you think P equals NP?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: The answer is no, although I'm told that somebody asked Jeff Dean if that was the key, under

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: what conditions P would equal NP, and he said either P is zero or N is one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Or vice versa, I've forgotten.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: This is what, Jeff Dean is a lot smarter than I am.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Your intuition is?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I have no intuition, but I've got a lot of colleagues who've got intuition and their

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: betting is no.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: That's the popular bet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: What is computational complexity theory?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Do you think these kinds of complexity classes, especially as you've taught in this modern

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: world, are still useful way to understand the hardness of problems?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I don't do that stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: The last time I touched anything to do with that-

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Many, many years ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: ... was before it was invented.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It's literally true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I did my PhD thesis on-

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Before Big O notation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Oh, absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I did this in 1968, and I worked on graph partitioning, which is this question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You've got a graph that is a nodes and edges kind of graph, and the edges have weights,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: and you just want to divide the nodes into two piles of equal size so that the number

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: of edges that goes from one side to the other is as small as possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You developed, so that problem is hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Well, as it turns out, I worked with Shen Lin at Bell Labs on this, and we were never able

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: to come up with anything that was guaranteed to give the right answer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: We came up with heuristics that worked pretty darn well, and I peeled off some special cases

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: for my thesis, but it was just hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: That was just about the time that Steve Cook was showing that there were classes of problems

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: that appeared to be really hard, of which graph partitioning was one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: My expertise, such as it was, totally predates that development.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Oh, interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109
