body.input: The heuristic, which now cares the two of your names for the traveling salesman problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: and for the graph partitioning, that was like how did you... You weren't even thinking

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: in terms of classes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You were just trying to find-

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: There was no such idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: A heuristic that kind of does the job pretty well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You were trying to find something that did the job, and there was nothing that you would

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: call it, say, a closed form or algorithmic thing that would give you a guaranteed right

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: answer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I mean, compare graph partitioning to max flow min cut or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: That's the same problem, except there's no constraint on the number of nodes on one side

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: or the other of the cut, and that means it's an easy problem, at least as I understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: it, whereas the constraint that says the two have to be constrained in size makes it a

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: hard problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, so Robert Frost has that poem where you have to choose two paths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Is there another alternate universe in which you pursued the Don Knuth path of algorithm

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: design sort of-

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Not smart enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Not smart enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You're infinitely modest, but so you pursued your love of programming.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: When you look back to those, I mean, just looking into that world, does that just seem

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: like a distant world of theoretical computer science?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Is it fundamentally different from the world of programming?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I mean, certainly in all seriousness, I just didn't have the talent for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: When I got here as a grad student to Princeton and I started to think about research at the

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: end of my first year or something like that, I worked briefly with John Hopcroft, who was

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: absolutely, you mentioned during award winner, et cetera, a great guy, and it became crystal

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: clear I was not cut out for this stuff, period.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And so I moved into things where I was more cut out for it and that tended to be things

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: like writing programs and then ultimately writing books.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You said that in Toronto as an undergrad, you did a senior thesis or a literature survey

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: on artificial intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: This was 1964.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Correct.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: What was the AI landscape, ideas, dreams at that time?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think that was one of the, well, you've heard of AI winters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: This is whatever the opposite was, AI summer or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It was one of these things where people thought that, boy, we could do anything with computers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: that all these hard problems, computers will solve them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: They will do machine translation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: They will play games like chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: They will do, you know, prove theorems in geometry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: There are all kinds of examples like that where people thought, boy, we could really

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: do those sorts of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And you know, I read the Kool-Aid in some sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I still have this wonderful collection of papers called Computers and Thought that was

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: published about that era and people were very optimistic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And then of course it turned out that what people thought was just a few years down the

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: pike was more than a few years down the pike.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And some parts of that are more or less now sort of under control.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: We finally do play games like Go and chess and so on better than people do, but there

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: are others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And machine translation is a lot better than it used to be, but that's, you know, 50, close

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: to 60 years of progress and a lot of evolution in hardware and a tremendous amount more data

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: up on which you can build systems that actually can learn from some of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And the infrastructure to support developers working together like an open source movement,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: the internet period is also empowering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: But what lesson do you draw from that, the opposite of winter, that optimism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Well, I guess the lesson is that in the short run, it's pretty easy to be too pessimistic

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: or maybe too optimistic and in the long run, you probably shouldn't be too pessimistic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I'm not saying that very well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It reminds me of this remark from Arthur Clarke, a science fiction author who says, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: when some distinguished but elderly person says that something is possible, he's probably

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And if he says it's impossible, he's almost surely wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: But you don't know what the time scale is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: The time scale is critical, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So what are your thoughts on this new summer of AI now in the work with machine learning

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: in your networks?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You've kind of mentioned that you started to try to explore and look into this world

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: that seems fundamentally different from the world of heuristics and algorithms like search,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: it's now purely sort of trying to take huge amounts of data and learn from that data,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And how do you look at that data?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Look, I think it's very interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I am incredibly far from an expert.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Most of what I know I've learned from my students and they're probably disappointed in how little

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I've learned from them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: But I think it has tremendous potential for certain kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I mean, games is one where it obviously has had an effect on some of the others as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think there's, and this is speaking from definitely not expertise, I think there are

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: serious problems in certain kinds of machine learning at least because what they're learning

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: from is the data that we give them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And if the data we give them has something wrong with it, then what they learn from it

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: is probably wrong too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: The obvious thing is some kind of bias in the data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: The data has stuff in it like, I don't know, women aren't as good as men at something,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: okay?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: That's just flat wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: But if it's in the data because of historical treatment, then that machine learning stuff

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: will propagate that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And that is a serious worry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: The positive part of that is what machine learning does is reveal the bias in the data

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: and puts a mirror to our own society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And in so doing helps us remove the bias, helps us work on ourselves, puts a mirror

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: to ourselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So that's an optimistic point of view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And if it works that way, that would be absolutely great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And what I don't know is whether it does work that way or whether the AI mechanisms or machine

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: learning mechanisms reinforce and amplify things that have been wrong in the past.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And I don't know, but I think that's a serious thing that we have to be concerned about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Let me ask you an out there question, okay?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I know nobody knows, but what do you think it takes to build a system of human level

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: intelligence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: That's been the dream from the 60s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: We talk about games, about language, about image recognition, but really the dream is

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: to create human level or superhuman level intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: What do you think it takes to do that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And are we close?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I haven't a clue and I don't know, roughly speaking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I mean, this was Turing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I was trying to trick you into a hypothesis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, I mean, Turing talked about this in his paper on machine intelligence back in

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: early 50s or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And he had the idea of the Turing test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And I don't know whether the Turing test is-

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Is a good test of intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It's an interesting test, at least in some vague sense objective, whether you can read

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: anything into the conclusions is a different story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Do you have worries, concerns, excitement about the future of artificial intelligence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So there's a lot of people who are worried and you can speak broadly than just artificial

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: intelligence is basically computing taking over the world in various forms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Are you excited by this future, this possibility of computing being everywhere or are you worried?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It's some combination of those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think almost all technologies over the long run are for good, but there's plenty of examples

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: where they haven't been good either over a long run for some people or over a short run.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And computing is one of those and AI within it is going to be one of those as well, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: computing broadly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I mean, for just a today example is privacy that the use of things like social media and

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: so on means that, and the commercial surveillance means that there's an enormous amount more

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: known about us by people, other businesses, government, whatever, than perhaps one ought

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: to feel comfortable with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So that's an example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: That's an example of a possible negative effect of computing being everywhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It's an interesting one because it could also be a positive if leveraged correctly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: There's a big if there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So I have a deep interest in human psychology and humans seem to be very paranoid about

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: this data thing that varies depending on age group.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It seems like the younger folks, so it's exciting to me to see what society looks like 50 years

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: from now that the concerns about privacy might be flipped on their head based purely on human

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: psychology versus actual concerns or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: What do you think about Moore's law?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You said a lot of stuff we've talked about with programming languages in their design

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: and their ideas come from the constraints in the systems they operate in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Do you think Moore's law, the exponential improvement of systems will continue indefinitely?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: There's a mix of opinions on that currently.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Or do you think there'll be a plateau?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Well the frivolous answer is no exponential can go on forever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You run out of something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Just as we said, timescale matters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So if it goes on long enough, that might be all we need.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Won't matter to us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: We've seen places where Moore's law has changed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: For example, mentioned earlier, processors don't get faster anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And you use that same growth of ability to put more things in a given area to grow them

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: horizontally instead of vertically as it were.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So you can get more and more processors or memory or whatever on the same chip.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Is that going to run into a limitation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Presumably, because at some point you get down to the individual atoms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And so you've got to find some way around that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Will we find some way around that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I just said that if I say it won't, I'll be wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Perhaps we will.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So I just talked to Jim Keller and he says, so he actually describes, he argues that the

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Moore's law will continue for a long, long time because you mentioned the atom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: We actually have, I think, a thousand fold increase, decrease in transistor size still

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: possible before we get to the quantum level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So there's still a lot of possibilities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: He thinks it'll continue indefinitely, which is an interesting optimistic viewpoint.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: But how do you think the programming languages will change with this increase?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Whether we hit a wall or not, what do you think?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Do you think there'll be a fundamental change in the way programming languages are designed?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I don't know about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think what will happen is continuation of what we see in some areas at least, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: is that more programming will be done by programs than by people and that more will be done

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: by sort of declarative rather than procedural mechanisms where I say, I want this to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You figure out how.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: That is in many cases at this point domain of specialized languages for narrow domains,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: but you can imagine that broadening out and so I don't have to say so much in so much

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: detail some collection of software, let's call it languages or programs or something

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: will figure out how to do what I want to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So increase levels of abstraction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And one day getting to the human level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: We'll just use natural language.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So you taught so teach a course computers in our world here at Princeton that introduces

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: computing and programming to non-majors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Just from that experience, what advice do you have for people who don't know anything

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: about programming but are kind of curious about this world or programming seems to become

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: more and more of a fundamental skill that people need to be at least aware of?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Well, I can recommend a good book.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: What's that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: The book I wrote for the course.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think this is one of these questions of should everybody know how to program?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And I think the answer is probably not, but I think everybody should at least understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: sort of what it is so that if you say to somebody I'm a programmer, they have a notion of what

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: that might be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Or if you say this is a program or this was decided by a computer running a program that

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: they have some vague intuitive understanding and accurate understanding of what that might

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: imply.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So part of what I'm doing in this course, which is very definitely for non-technical

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: people and a typical person in it is a history or English major, try and explain how computers

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: work, how they do their thing, what programming is, how you write a program, and how computers

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: talk to each other and what do they do when they're talking to each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And then I would say nobody very rarely and does anybody in that course go on to become

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: a real serious programmer, but at least they've got a somewhat better idea of what all this

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: stuff is about, not just the programming, but the technology behind computers and communications.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Do they try and write a program themselves?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Oh yeah, yeah, a very small amount.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I introduced them to how machines work at a level below high level languages.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So we have a kind of a toy machine that has a very small repertoire, a dozen instructions

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: and they write trivial assembly language programs for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Really?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So can you just, if you were to give a flavor to people of the programming world, of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: computing world, what are the examples that you should go with?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So a little bit of assembly to get a sense at the lowest level of what the program is

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: really doing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, I mean, in some sense, there's no such thing as the lowest level because you can

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: keep going down, but that's the place where I drew the line.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So the idea that computers have a fairly small repertoire of very simple instructions that

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: they can do like add and subtract and branch and so on, as you mentioned earlier, and that

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: you can write code at that level and it will get things done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And then you have the levels of abstraction that we get with higher level languages like

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Fortran or C or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And that makes it easier to write the code and less dependent on particular architectures.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And then we talk about a lot of the different kinds of programs that they use all the time

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: that they don't probably realize are programs, like they're running Mac OS on their computers

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: or maybe Windows, and they're downloading apps on their phones.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And all of those things are programs that are just what we just talked about, except

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: at a grand scale.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, it's easy to forget that they're actual programs that people program.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: There's engineers that wrote those things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So in a way, I'm expecting them to make an enormous conceptual leap from their five or

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: 10 line toy assembly language thing that adds two or three numbers to something that is

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: a browser on their phone or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: But it's really the same thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So if you look at the broad strokes of history, how do you think the world changed because

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: of computers?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It's hard to sometimes see the big picture when you're in it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: But I guess I'm asking if there's something you've noticed over the years that, like you

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: mentioned, the students are more distracted looking at their...

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Now there's a device to look at.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Well, I think computing has changed a tremendous amount, obviously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: But I think one aspect of that is the way that people interact with each other, both

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: locally and far away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And when I was the age of those kids, making a phone call to somewhere was a big deal because

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: it costs serious money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And this was in the 60s, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And today, people don't make phone calls.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: They send texts or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So there's an up and down in what people do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: People think nothing of having correspondence, regular meetings, video, whatever with friends

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: or family or whatever in any other part of the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And they don't think about that at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And so that's just the communication aspect of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And do you think that brings us closer together or does it take us away from the closeness

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: of human to human contact?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think it depends a lot on all kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So I trade mail with my brother and sister in Canada much more often than I used to talk

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: to them on the phone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So probably every two or three days, I get something or send something to them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Whereas 20 years ago, I probably wouldn't have talked to them on the phone nearly as

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So in that sense, that's brought my brother and sister and I closer together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: That's a good thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I watch the kids on campus and they're mostly walking around with their heads down, fooling

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: with their phones to the point where I have to duck them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I don't know that that has brought them closer together in some ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: There's sociological research that says people are in fact not as close together as they

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: used to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I don't know whether that's really true, but I can see potential downsides and kids

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: where you think, come on, wake up and smell the coffee or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: That's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So you look at, again, nobody can predict the future, but are you excited?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Kind of touch this a little bit with AI, but are you excited by the future in the next

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: 10, 20 years that computing will bring?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: You were there when there was no computers really, and now computers are everywhere,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: all over the world, in Africa and Asia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Every person, almost every person in the world has a device.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So are you hopeful, optimistic about that future?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It's mixed, if the truth be told.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think there are some things about that that are good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think there's the potential for people to improve their lives all over the place,

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: and that's obviously good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: At the same time, at least in the short run, you can see lots and lots of bad as people

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: become more tribalistic or parochial in their interests and there's an enormous amount

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: more us and them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: People are using computers in all kinds of ways to mislead or misrepresent or flat out

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: lie about what's going on, and that is affecting politics locally and I think everywhere in

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: The long-term effect on political systems and so on is who knows.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Who knows indeed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: The people now have a voice, which is a powerful thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: People who are oppressed have a voice, but also everybody has a voice and the chaos that

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: emerges from that is fascinating to watch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, it's kind of scary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: If you can go back and relive a moment in your life, one that made you truly happy outside

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: of family or was profoundly transformative, is there a moment or moments that jump out

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: at you from memory?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I don't think specific moments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: I think there were lots and lots and lots of good times at Bell Labs where you would

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: build something and it worked.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Jeez, it worked.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: The moment it worked.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, and somebody used it and they said, gee, that's neat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Those kinds of things happened quite often in that golden era in the 70s when Unix was

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: young and there was all this low-hanging fruit and interesting things to work on and a group

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: of people who kind of, we were all together in this and if you did something, they would

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: try it out for you and I think that was in some sense a really, really good time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And Auk was Auk an example of that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: When you built it and people used it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And now millions of people use it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: And all your stupid mistakes are right there for them to look at, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So it's mixed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Yeah, it's terrifying and vulnerable, but it's beautiful because it does have a positive

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: impact on so, so many people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: So I think there's no better way to end it, Brian.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Thank you so much for talking to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: It was an honor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Brian Kernighan: UNIX, C, AWK, AMPL, and Go Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #109

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: He's the author of several books

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: on natural and artificial intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: including his new book, Rebooting AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Building Machines We Can Trust.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Gary has been a critical voice,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: highlighting the limits of deep learning and AI in general

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and discussing the challenges before our AI community

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that must be solved in order to achieve

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: artificial general intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: As I'm having these conversations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I try to find paths toward insight, towards new ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I try to have no ego in the process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: It gets in the way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I'll often continuously try on several hats,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: several roles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: One, for example, is the role of a three-year-old

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: who understands very little about anything

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and asks big what and why questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: The other might be a role of a devil's advocate

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: who presents counter ideas with the goal of arriving

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: at greater understanding through debate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Hopefully, both are useful, interesting,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and even entertaining at times.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I ask for your patience as I learn

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: to have better conversations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: This is the Artificial Intelligence Podcast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: If you enjoy it, subscribe on YouTube,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: give it five stars on iTunes, support it on Patreon,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: or simply connect with me on Twitter

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: at Lex Friedman, spelled F-R-I-D-M-A-N.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And now, here's my conversation with Gary Marcus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Do you think human civilization will one day have

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: to face an AI-driven technological singularity

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that will, in a societal way, modify our place

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: in the food chain of intelligent living beings

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: on this planet?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I think our place in the food chain has already changed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So there are lots of things people used to do by hand

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that they do with machine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: If you think of a singularity as like one single moment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: which is, I guess, what it suggests,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I don't know if it'll be like that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: but I think that there's a lot of gradual change

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and AI is getting better and better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I mean, I'm here to tell you why I think it's not nearly

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: as good as people think, but the overall trend is clear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Maybe Ray Kurzweil thinks it's an exponential,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and I think it's linear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: In some cases, it's close to zero right now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: but it's all gonna happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I mean, we are gonna get to human level intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: or whatever you want, artificial general intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: at some point, and that's certainly gonna change our place

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: in the food chain, because a lot of the tedious things

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that we do now, we're gonna have machines do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and a lot of the dangerous things that we do now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: we're gonna have machines do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I think our whole lives are gonna change

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: from people finding their meaning through their work

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: through people finding their meaning

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: through creative expression.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So the singularity will be a very gradual,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: in fact, removing the meaning of the word singularity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: it'll be a very gradual transformation in your view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I think that it'll be somewhere in between,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and I guess it depends what you mean by gradual and sudden.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I don't think it's gonna be one day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I think it's important to realize that intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: is a multi-dimensional variable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So people sort of write this stuff as if IQ was one number,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and the day that you hit 262 or whatever,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: you displace the human beings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And really, there's lots of facets to intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So there's verbal intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and there's motor intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and there's mathematical intelligence and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Machines in their mathematical intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: far exceed most people already,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: in their ability to play games,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: they far exceed most people already.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: In their ability to understand language,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: they lag behind my five-year-old,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: far behind my five-year-old.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So there are some facets of intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that machines have grasped, and some that they haven't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And we have a lot of work left to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: to get them to, say, understand natural language,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: or to understand how to flexibly approach

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: some kind of novel MacGyver problem-solving

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: kind of situation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And I don't know that all of these things will come once.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I think there are certain vital prerequisites
