metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: look like 100 years from now?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: If you would just, you can't predict,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: but if you were to philosophize and imagine, do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Can I first justify the arrogance

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: before you try to push me beyond it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I mean, there are examples like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: people figured out how electricity worked.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: They had no idea that that was gonna lead to cell phones.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I mean, things can move awfully fast

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: once new technologies are perfected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Even when they made transistors,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: they weren't really thinking that cell phones

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: would lead to social networking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: There are nevertheless predictions of the future,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: which are statistically unlikely to come to be,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: but nevertheless is the best.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: You're asking me to be wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Asking you to be statistically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: In which way would I like to be wrong?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Pick the least unlikely to be wrong thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: even though it's most very likely to be wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I mean, here's some things

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that we can safely predict, I suppose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: We can predict that AI will be faster than it is now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: It will be cheaper than it is now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: It will be better in the sense of being more general

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and applicable in more places.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: It will be pervasive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I mean, these are easy predictions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I'm sort of modeling them in my head

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: on Jeff Bezos' famous predictions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: He says, I can't predict the future,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: not in every way, I'm paraphrasing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: but I can predict that people will never wanna pay

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: more money for their stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: They're never gonna want it to take longer to get there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And so, you can't predict everything,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: but you can predict something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Sure, of course it's gonna be faster and better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: But what we can't really predict

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: is the full scope of where AI will be in a certain period.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I mean, I think it's safe to say that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: although I'm very skeptical about current AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that it's possible to do much better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: You know, there's no in principle argument

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that says AI is an insolvable problem,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that there's magic inside our brains

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that will never be captured.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I mean, I've heard people make those kinds of arguments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I don't think they're very good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So AI is gonna come, and probably 500 years

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: is plenty to get there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And then once it's here, it really will change everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So when you say AI is gonna come,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: are you talking about human level intelligence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So maybe I-

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I like the term general intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So I don't think that the ultimate AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: if there is such a thing, is gonna look just like humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I think it's gonna do some things that humans do

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: better than current machines, like reason flexibly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And understand language and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: But it doesn't mean they have to be identical to humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So for example, humans have terrible memory

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and they suffer from what some people

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: call motivated reasoning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So they like arguments that seem to support them

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and they dismiss arguments that they don't like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: There's no reason that a machine should ever do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So you see that those, the limitations of memory

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: as a bug, not a feature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I'll say two things about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: One is I was on a panel with Danny Kahneman,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: the Nobel Prize winner last night,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and we were talking about this stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And I think what we converged on is that

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: humans are a low bar to exceed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: They may be outside of our skill right now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: but as AI programmers, but eventually AI will exceed it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So we're not talking about human level AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: we're talking about general intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that can do all kinds of different things

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and do it without some of the flaws that human beings have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: The other thing I'll say is I wrote a whole book actually

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: about the flaws of humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: It's actually a nice book end to the, or counterpoint

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: to the current book.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So I wrote a book called Cluj,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: which was about the limits of the human mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: The current book is kind of about those few things

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that humans do a lot better than machines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Do you think it's possible that the flaws

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: of the human mind, the limits of memory, our mortality,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: our bias is a strength, not a weakness?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: That is the thing that enables from which motivation springs

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and meaning springs?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I've heard a lot of arguments like this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I've never found them that convincing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I think that there's a lot of making lemonade out of lemons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So we, for example, do a lot of free association

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: where one idea just leads to the next

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and they're not really that well connected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And we enjoy that and we make poetry out of it

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and we make kind of movies with free associations

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and it's fun and whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I don't think that's really a virtue of the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I think that the limitations in human reasoning

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: actually get us in a lot of trouble.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Like, for example, politically, we can't see eye to eye

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: because we have the motivational reasoning

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I was talking about and something related

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: called confirmation bias.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So we have all of these problems that actually make

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: for a rougher society because we can't get along

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: because we can't interpret the data in shared ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And then we do some nice stuff with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So my free associations are different from yours

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and you're kind of amused by them and that's great

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and hence poetry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So there are lots of ways in which we take

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: a lousy situation and make it good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Another example would be our memories are terrible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So we play games like concentration where you flip over

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: two cards, try to find a pair.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Can you imagine a computer playing that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Computers like this is the dullest game in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I know where all the cards are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I see it once, I know where it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: What are you even talking about?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So we make a fun game out of having this terrible memory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So we are imperfect in discovering and optimizing

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: some kind of utility function, but you think in general,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: there is a utility function.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: There's an objective function that's better than others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I didn't say that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: But see the presumption, when you say...

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I think you could design a better memory system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: You could argue about utility functions

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and how you wanna think about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: But objectively, it would be really nice to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: some of the following things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: To get rid of memories that are no longer useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Objectively, that would just be good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And we're not that good at it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So when you park in the same lot every day,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: you confuse where you parked today

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: with where you parked yesterday,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: with where you parked the day before and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So you blur together a series of memories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: There's just no way that that's optimal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I mean, I've heard all kinds of wacky arguments,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: people trying to defend that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: But in the end of the day,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I don't think any of them hold water.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Or trauma, memories of traumatic events

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: would be possibly a very nice feature to have

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: to get rid of those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: It'd be great if you could just be like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I'm gonna wipe this sector.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I'm done with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I didn't have fun last night.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I don't wanna think about it anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Whoop, bye bye.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I'm gone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: But we can't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Do you think it's possible to build a system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that I like common sense, but that chapter actually starts

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: by us beating up not on deep learning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: but kind of on our own home team, as it will.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So Ernie and I are first and foremost people that believe

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: in at least some of what good old fashioned AI try to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So we believe in symbols and logic and programming,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: things like that are important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And we go through why even those tools

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that we hold fairly dear aren't really enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So we talk about why common sense is actually many things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And some of them fit really well

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: with those classical sets of tools.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So things like taxonomy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So I know that a bottle is an object

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: or it's a vessel, let's say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And I know a vessel is an object

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and objects are material things in the physical world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So like I can make some inferences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: If I know that vessels need to not have holes in them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: then I can infer that in order to carry their contents,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: then I can infer that a bottle shouldn't have a hole

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: in order to carry its contents.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So you can do hierarchical inference and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And we say that's great, but it's only a tiny piece

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: of what you need for common sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: We give lots of examples that don't fit into that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So another one that we talk about is a cheese grater.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: You've got holes in a cheese grater.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: You've got a handle on top.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: You can build a model in the game engine sense of a model

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: so that you could have a little cartoon character

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: flying around through the holes of the grater.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: But we don't have a system yet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Taxonomy doesn't help us that much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: That really understands why the handle is on top

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and what you do with the handle

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: or why all of those circles are sharp

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: or how you'd hold the cheese with respect to the grater

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: in order to make it actually work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Do you think these ideas are just abstractions

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that could emerge on the system

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: like a very large deep neural network?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I'm a skeptic that that kind of emergence per se can work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So I think that deep learning might play a role

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: in the systems that do what I want systems to do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: but it won't do it by itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I've never seen a deep learning system

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: really extract an abstract concept.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: What they do, principled reasons for that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: stemming from how back propagation works,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: how the architectures are set up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: One example is deep learning people actually all build in

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: something like convol...

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Build in something called convolution,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: which Jan Lekoon is famous for, which is an abstraction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: They don't have their systems learn this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So the abstraction is an object looks the same

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: if it appears in different places.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And what Lekoon figured out and why,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: essentially why he was a co-winner of the Turing Award

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: was that if you programmed this in innately,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: then your system would be a whole lot more efficient.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: In principle, this should be learnable,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: but people don't have systems that kind of reify things

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and make them more abstract.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And so what you'd really wind up with

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: if you don't program that in advance is a system

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that kind of realizes that this is the same thing as this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: but then I take your little clock there and I move it over

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and it doesn't realize that the same thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: applies to the clock.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So the really nice thing, you're right,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that convolution is just one of the things that's like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: it's an innate feature that's programmed by the human expert.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: But we need more of those, not less.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So yes, but the nice feature is it feels like that requires

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: coming up with that brilliant idea,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: can get you a Turing Award, but it requires less effort

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: than encoding, and something we'll talk about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: the expert system, so encoding a lot of knowledge by hand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So it feels like one, there's a huge amount of limitations

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: which you clearly outline with deep learning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: but the nice feature of deep learning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: whatever it is able to accomplish,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: it does a lot of stuff automatically

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: without human intervention.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Well, and that's part of why people love it, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: But I always think of this quote from Bertrand Russell,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: which is, it has all the advantages of theft

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: over honest toil.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: It's really hard to program into a machine

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: a notion of causality, or even how a bottle works,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: or what containers are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Ernie Davis and I wrote a, I don't know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: 45 page academic paper trying just to understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: what a container is, which I don't think anybody

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: ever read the paper, but it's a very detailed analysis

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: of all the things, well, not even all of it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: some of the things you need to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: in order to understand a container.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: It would be a whole lot nice, and you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I'm a co-author on the paper, I made it a little bit better,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: but Ernie did the hard work for that particular paper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And it took him like three months

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: to get the logical statements correct,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and maybe that's not the right way to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: It's a way to do it, but on that way of doing it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: it's really hard work to do something as simple

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: as understanding containers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and nobody wants to do that hard work,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: even Ernie didn't want to do that hard work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Everybody would rather just like feed their system

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: in with a bunch of videos with a bunch of containers

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and have the systems infer how containers work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: It would be like so much less effort,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: let the machine do the work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And so I understand the impulse,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I understand why people want to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I just don't think that it works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I've never seen anybody build a system

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that in a robust way can actually watch videos

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and predict exactly, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: which containers would leak

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and which ones wouldn't or something like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and I know someone's gonna go out and do that

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: since I said it, and I look forward to seeing it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: but getting these things to work robustly

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: is really, really hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So Jan LeCun, who was my colleague at NYU for many years,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: thinks that the hard work should go into defining

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: an unsupervised learning algorithm

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: that will watch videos, use the next frame basically

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: in order to tell it what's going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And he thinks that's the royal road,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and he's willing to put in the work

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: in devising that algorithm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: Then he wants the machine to do the rest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And again, I understand the impulse.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: My intuition based on years of watching this stuff

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and making predictions 20 years ago that still hold,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: even though there's a lot more computation and so forth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: is that we actually have to do a different kind of hard work,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: which is more like building a design specification

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: for what we want the system to do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: doing hard engineering work to figure out

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: how we do things like what Jan did for convolution

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: in order to figure out how to encode complex,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: knowledge into the systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: The current systems don't have that much knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: other than convolution, which is again,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: objects being in different places

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and having the same perception, I guess I'll say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: same appearance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: People don't wanna do that work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: They don't see how to naturally fit one with the other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: I think that's, yes, absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: But also on the expert system side,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: there's a temptation to go too far the other way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So it was just having an expert sort of sit down

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: and encode the description, the framework

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: for what a container is, and then having the system

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: reason the rest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: From my view, one really exciting possibility

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: is of active learning where it's continuous interaction

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: between a human and machine, as the machine,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: there's kind of deep learning type extraction

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: of information from data, patterns, and so on,

body.input: One of the kinds of classical neural network architecture

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: So I did some experiments in 1998

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

metadata.title: Podcast: Gary Marcus: Toward a Hybrid of Deep Learning and Symbolic AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #43

body.input: And now let me leave you with some words of wisdom

body.input: The important thing is not to stop questioning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Stevens: Vsauce | Lex Fridman Podcast #58

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Stevens: Vsauce | Lex Fridman Podcast #58

body.input: of life, the marvelous structure of reality.

body.input: The following is a conversation with Robert Breedlove,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: someone who caught my attention

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and thinker in the space of decentralized finance

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and Bitcoin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: His podcast titled, What Is Money,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: is a good representation of the way his mind works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: He's willing to talk through ideas for many hours,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: willing to listen, willing to think,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: which makes him a great companion in conversation

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176
