body.input: As a side note, let me say that I'll have

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: a number of conversations in the coming months

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: on Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: None of these conversations are financial advice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: That's not a legal warning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: That's a genuine description of my goals

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and approach with these chats.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: At least for a while, I personally won't actively invest

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: in Bitcoin or any other cryptocurrencies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: except to learn about the technology itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: I don't think this should be a journalistic standard

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: like the New York Times trying to establish,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: which I very much disagree with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: In my humble opinion, I think journalists should be free

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: to invest in Bitcoin if they want to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Luckily, I'm not a journalist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: I just know my own psychology

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and I feel that my thinking will be muddled by excitement

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: if I invest before I understand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: I feel the same way about Tesla, for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: I still don't own any Tesla stock

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and I am still indeed fascinated by Tesla autopilot

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: as an artificial intelligence system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: I work hard to be cognizant of the biases

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: that arise in my mind and always try to choose the path

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: that maximizes or maintains a freedom of thought

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: as much as possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Also, let me say that I try to be very careful

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: in selecting guests based not only on the contents

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: of their ideas, but the richness, complexity, music,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: style of their mind and character.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Yes, I will talk with people with whom you

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and I may disagree, people who some may call bad

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: or even evil human beings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: I want to understand them because I believe that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: as Sol Janitzen said, the battle line between good

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and evil runs through the heart of every man.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: I think if you always run from evil,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: you become blind to the truth of human nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: This is the Lex Friedman podcast

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and here is my conversation with Robert Breedlove.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Rousseau opens his 1762 book, The Social Contract,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: with the following statement.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: "'Man is born free and everywhere he is in chains.'"

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So you talk about freedom and sovereignty quite a bit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: What do these ideas mean to you, the idea of sovereignty?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Freedom and sovereignty, I think they're very closely related.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: When we start just focusing on sovereignty,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: which is a word I don't think we talk about enough,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and the general definition of that I would give

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: is the authority to act as you see fit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And it's a word that's etymologically associated

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: with words like monarchy, money, reign.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So historically, it's referred to whatever the locus

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: of supreme power is in the sphere of human action.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So whether if you go back into ancient Egypt,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: the pharaoh had absolute sovereignty

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and everyone else was pretty much operating

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: according to his interest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: You fast forward to today, modern Western democracy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: we have more decentralized sovereignty

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: in that we all get to go vote and elect officials

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: that make decisions on our behalf.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So the theme of sovereignty across history

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: is that it's been gradually decentralizing

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: across our different models of socioeconomics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And it's largely, you can say it's rooted heavily

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: in the money, I would argue,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: which is something we'll get a lot into here,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: where if you have money, you have the authority

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: to act as you see fit in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And even in our current political sphere,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: if you have enough money, you can actually reshape the rules.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: You can reshape laws, you can lobby Congress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: If you're in a certain situation like many billionaires,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: you can negotiate your own tax treaty,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: such that you can get favorable tax treatment

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: with certain jurisdictions in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So this concept of sovereignty,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: which today we call, it's common to call states

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: or nation states or government sovereign,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: meaning that they have power over people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: But as I argue in a lot of my writing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: I actually think that sovereignty

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and here's within the individual

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and that we each have our own interiorized space of choice,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: which is something like Viktor Frankl

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: called the final human freedom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And that we, no matter what our circumstances are,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: no matter what exogenous situation we face,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: we always have this endogenous power

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: to choose how we respond to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: That's one of my favorite books is Man's Search for Meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Maybe we can break that apart a little bit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So you've kind of spoken about sovereignty

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: as closely linked to power,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: but is there something about your own mind

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: being able to achieve sovereignty

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: no matter what the monetary system is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: no matter what, who has the control over centralized power,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: the money or whatever the mechanisms of sovereignty

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and the societal level, you as an individual,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: isn't ultimately all boiled down to

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: what you can do with your mind, how you see the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Yes. I agree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And as we get a little bit deeper into this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: I think we'll come to see money

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: as an extension of your mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So there's a feedback between money and mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: For instance, you think in dollars today,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: almost guarantee it, most of us do here in the US.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And it's a tool, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: It's a tool we're using to decomplexify the world around us

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: to deal with it, to understand the sacrifices and successes

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: across an entire history of economic transactions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: We can boil that all down to the price.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So it's data compression.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And if you can change, if there's a central body

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: or central governance mechanism

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: that can manipulate that money,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: it can have an impact on your mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: For instance, today, so I agree with you on the firsthand,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: say that I do believe in free will,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: I do believe in individual autonomy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: but I also think that there are certain devices and powers

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: in the world around us

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: that can actually influence how we think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And it's fascinating to think about the fact

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: that money might be actually deeply integrated

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: into the way we think and into our mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Like this is, you think about what are the core aspects

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: of the human mind?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: What influences cognition,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: the way you reason about the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: You have the Chomsky like languages

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: at the core of everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: But you're kind of placing money as pretty close

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: to the core of what it means to be

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: an intelligent reasoning human.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: I think money is a direct derivation

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: of action and speech actually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: It's another expression of the logos.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: If we even think of what it means to think

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: is that we are generating two different courses of action,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: potential courses of action,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and we're populating them with avatars, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Maybe ourself or others,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and then we're comparing how we may act in each situation

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and what we think the result would be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So actually it's comparison,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: basically it's comparison and contrasting of possible

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: courses of action.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And that's the same thing with words themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Like, most words, the vast majority of words

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: only have meaning in relationship to other words, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: It's all contextual definitions of a word or more words.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Now people have argued with me about this

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: because there is a first word, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Where you pick up rock and say rock.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: But most other words and much in higher abstraction

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: tend to be relative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: we have grain, stock houses of grain to defend

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: or maybe meat or cattle

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: or whatever it is we're creating, we now have savings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And it's at that time when government emerges as well

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: because once you have savings

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: or you have an economic surplus,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: you have something that other people want to steal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: This one thing we'll touch on a lot today

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: is people always want something for nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: People are always seeking the path

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: to get something for nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And I think that drives a lot of our decision-making

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and actually encourages us to be innovative

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: in a lot of ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: We're trying to, you could say it's our laziness

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: that's helping us be inventive in a way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: We're trying to accomplish greater results

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: with less efforts over time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: but we can cross that line

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: in seeking something for nothing

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: where we start to violate the life, liberty

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and property of others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And that's where we shift from kind of capitalistic society

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: to something more communistic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And so that's what government is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: It's a protection producing enterprise

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: for the economic surplus generated by a trading society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So when people begin to trade,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: they create what's called the division of labor,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: which is a very common economics term,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: basically means you're better at making hats,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: I'm better at making boots.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: I specialize in boots and we trade,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: we've created a positive sum game

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: where you and I both benefit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So we become collectively more than the sum of our parts

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: through trade.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And that's why human beings do trade

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: We create more outputs per unit of input.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And you can think of government in that respect,

body.input: if we're looking at it, maybe in a tech sense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and we can have a reasonable expectation

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And an 8 trillion of that is demand

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: for its use as a store value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Money, the marketability aspects of money boils down

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: to five services that money can render.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Money needs to be divisible, it needs to be durable,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: it needs to be recognizable, it needs to be portable,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and it needs to be scarce.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So I'll gloss over a lot of history with this

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and just say that historically,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: money's always been a technology,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: still is a technology or a tool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: I use these terms interchangeably,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and you think of a technology

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: as just a more sophisticated tool effectively.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: To best satisfy those properties, monetary metals

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: were determined to be the most satisfactory tool,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: the most divisible, most durable, most recognizable,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: most portable tool in the marketplace.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Of the monetary metals, gold was the most scarce

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: as quantified by either its stock to flow ratio

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: or its inflation resistance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So simple way to say this is that people always prefer

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: the money most resistant to inflation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: That's a nice definition of scarcity in the context.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: The money is, if you were to measure it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: the resistance to inflation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So how hard is it to artificially increase the supply

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: of the thing? That is the hardness of money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And that's why gold is hard money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Because alchemy is hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: That's right, because no one cracked the alchemy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: so gold became money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So that's such a nice clean explanation of what is money

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: with the five elements and gold ultimately won out

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: because of the last piece of scarcity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: That's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And to get to maybe dig a little deeper there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So scarcity, we commonly think of scarcity

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: as strictly a supply property,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: where if there's not much of something, then it's scarce.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: But it's not actually true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Scarcity occurs when demand exceeds supply.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So when there's more demand than the supply can justify,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: the thing becomes an economic good

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and it establishes itself a market price.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So there's more demand for the thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: than the supply can satisfy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: The unique thing about money as a concept at least

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: is that demand always exceeds supply.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: There's never enough money to satisfy everyone, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Because another definition for money,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: it's the most marketable good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So it can be traded for any other good service

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: piece of knowledge in the marketplace.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So humans being what we are, we're never satisfied, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: We always want more of something, whatever it may be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So money as the ultimate token of obtaining that something

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: is always scarce as a concept.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: But the problem with money is that if you can,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: as you alluded to, easily increase its supply,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: then all of a sudden you can compromise

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: the scarcity of it over time

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and you can rob people through inflation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So that's why the market's settled on gold as money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And robbing is reallocating the value that I,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: so essentially the one property,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: like why scarcity is important

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: is it adds a lot more friction to the reallocation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Like through essentially violence or implied violence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Well, it prevents it through cost of extraction too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So if you want to go out and dilute gold holders today,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: you have to go out into the world and mine gold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: It's a very expensive process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: That process tends to find equilibrium

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: where production cost equals the market value of gold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So if market value is $2,000 an ounce today of gold,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: its production cost is gonna be around there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: That's the natural market equilibrium.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So that way gold miners cannot just dilute people over time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Whereas you look at something like fiat currency,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: which we're jumping ahead a little bit,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: but its production cost is zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So there's a reason the market value of fiat currency

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: historically has always converged to zero

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: because its production cost is near zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So the extension to that question might be

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: how did we get from gold to paper currency?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And again, this is rooted in the properties of money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: As good as monetary metals were and as good as gold is

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: as money at holding value across time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: it's rather limited in terms of portability.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: It is not as useful for moving value across space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: This is another definition of money, by the way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: a social device for moving value across space and time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So to rectify this technological shortcoming of gold,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: we introduced, first of all,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: the custody of gold was gradually centralized

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: into more, into fewer and fewer warehousing operations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: This is because there are economies of scale associated

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: with using gold as money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And that if you centralize the custody,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: the warehouse owner can then issue a paper receipt

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: called a warehouse receipt for that gold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And then market participants can trade that paper

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: as if it's good as gold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And everyone has an option at any time

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: to go and redeem real gold from the warehouse.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So that system works until the problem with it

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: is that it introduces the need to trust the custodian.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So it's introducing counterparty risk

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: in the form of the custodian.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And now should that warehouse choose to increase the supply

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: of paper notes to gold beyond its supply.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: So if it's got three tons of gold

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and it issues six tons worth of paper receipts,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: all of a sudden it's participating in a fraud.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: It's basically lying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: It's representing that it has more gold

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: than it actually does.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And that is the pathway that we got into banking

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: and central banking is we needed a convenience mechanism

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: to rectify the portability shortcomings of gold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: We needed to be able to move value across space, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Gold was doing a great job at moving value over time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: but not space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Paper currency gave us the ability

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: to move value across space,

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: but it introduced this attack vector

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: To get something for nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Just a little bit at first.

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Just this one morning, just a little bit.

body.input: I mean, I don't know if you can speak

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: to the birth of a fiat currency.

body.input: to those early steps that created it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: Like could it have been averted?

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

metadata.title: Podcast: Robert Breedlove: Philosophy of Bitcoin from First Principles | Lex Fridman Podcast #176

body.input: And in the digital age,
