body.input: Yeah, by the way, I should push back on the billionaires because there's sometimes a negative

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: connotation to the word billionaire. It's not a billionaire. It's a company versus government

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: because governments are billionaires and trillionaires. It's not the wealth. It's

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: the capitalist imperative, which I think deserves a lot more praise than people are giving it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: I'm troubled by the sort of criticism like it's billionaires playing with toys for their own

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: pleasure. I think what some of these companies like SpaceX and Blue Origin are doing is some of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: most inspiring engineering and even scientific work ever done in human history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: No, I agree. I think the people who've made the greatest wealth are people who've really been

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: mega benefactors. I mean, I think... Some of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: Yeah, yeah. Some of them. But those who founded Google and all that and even Amazon,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: they're beneficiaries. They're in a quite different category in my view from those who just

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: shuffle around money or crypto coins and things like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: You're not really talking trash. Yes. But I think if they use their money in

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: these ways, that's fine. But I think it's true that far more money is owned by us collectively as

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: taxpayers. But I think the fact is, it's in a democracy, there'd be big resistance to exposing

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: human beings to very high risks if in a sense we share responsibility for it. That's the reason I

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: think it'd be done much more cheaply by these private funders. That's an interesting hypothesis,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: but I have to push back. I don't know if it's obvious why NASA spends so much money and

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: takes such a long time to develop the things it was doing. So before Elon Musk came along,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: because I would love to live in a world where government actually uses taxpayer money to get

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: some of the best engineers and scientists in the world and actually work across governments,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: 10 to the minus 21.

body.input: So maybe, actually, if we step back, what are black holes? What do we humans understand about

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: as that can be so big and can lurk in the solar system. And so that's the situation for a

body.input: And,

body.input: Okay, well, I think one thing that only became understood, really, in the 1950s, I suppose,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: and beyond was how stars evolve differently, depending on how heavy they are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: Yeah. The sun burns hydrogen to helium,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: and then when it's run out of that, it contracts to be a white dwarf. And we know how long that

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: will take. It'll take about 10 billion years altogether for its lifetime. But big stars

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: burn up their fuel more quickly and more interestingly, because when they turn hydrogen

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: to helium, they then get even hotter. So they can fuse helium into carbon and go up the periodic

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: table. And then they eventually explode when they have an energy crisis, and they blow out that

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: process material, which as a digression is crucially important because all the atoms inside our bodies

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: were synthesized inside a star, a star that lived and died more than 5 billion years ago

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: before our sources were formed. And so we each have inside us atoms made in thousands of different

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: stars all over the Milky Way. And that's an amazing idea. And my predecessor, Fred Hoyle,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: in 1946 was the first person to suggest that idea. And that's been born out. That's a wonderful idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: So that's how massive stars explode. And they leave behind something which is very exotic and

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: of two kinds. One possibility is a neutron star. And these were first discovered in 1967, 68. These

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: are stars a bit heavier than the Sun, which are compressed to an amazing density. So the whole mass

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: of more than the Sun's mass is in something about 10 miles across. So they're extraordinarily dense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: very exotic physics. And they've been studied in immense detail. And they've been real laboratories,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: because the good thing about astronomy, apart from exploring what's out there, is to use the fact that

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: the cosmos has provided us with a lab with far more extreme conditions than we could ever simulate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And so we learn lots of basic physics from looking at these objects. And that's been true

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: neutron star. But for black holes, that's even more true because the bigger stars, when they collapse,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: they leave something behind in the center, which is too big to be a stable white or four neutron

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: star and becomes a black hole. And we know that there are lots of black holes weighing about

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: 10 or up to 50 times as much as the Sun, which are the remnants of stars. They were detected

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: first 50 years ago when a black hole was orbiting around another star and grabbing material from the

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: objects orbiting around an ordinary star and emitting x-ray radiation very intensely,

body.input: varying on a very short time scale. So something very small and dense was giving that radiation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: realizing that there was a different class of monster black holes in the center of galaxies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: the galaxy. Giant beam of light. And in many cases, it's a beam.

body.input: Is that, that's gotta be the most epic thing the universe produces is quasars.

body.input: they're still a mystery. And you can only see them.

body.input: not resolved by a telescope, but outshone an entire galaxy.

body.input: Yeah. That's suspicious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: producing far more energy than all the stars added together. And it was the energy of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: black hole that was lighting up all the gas in the galaxy. So you've got a spectrum of it.

body.input: So this was something which was realized from the 1970s onwards. And it was a very interesting

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: Black hole generating jets of light. Yeah.

body.input: In the center of most galaxies. Do we know, do we have a sense if every galaxy has one of these big,

body.input: murdering or consuming, however you put it. Yeah, that's right. And so it's thought that

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And even in these long perspectives, then indeed this century is very special because it may see

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And that'll be an important transition in biology and complexity in this century.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: But of course, the other importance, and this has been the theme of a couple of my older books,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: is that this is the first century when one species, namely our species, has the future of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: planet in its hands. And that's because of two types of concerns. One is that there are more of

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: us, we're more demanding of energy and resources, and therefore we are for the first time changing

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: the whole planet through climate change, loss of biodiversity, and all those issues. This has never

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: happened in the past because there haven't been enough humans, so this is an effect that's

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: obviously high on everyone's agenda now, and rightly so because we've got to ensure that we leave a

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: heritage that isn't eroded or damaged to future generations. And so that's one class of threats.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: But there's another thing that worries me, perhaps more than many people seem to worry,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: and that's the threat of misuse of technology. And so this is particularly because technologies

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: empower even small groups of malevolent people, or indeed even careless people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: to create some effect which could cascade globally. And to take an example, a dangerous pathogen or

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: pandemic. I mean, my worst nightmare is that there could be some small group that can engineer a

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: virus to make it more virulent or more transmissible than a natural virus. This is so-called

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: gain-of-function experiments which were done on the flu virus 10 years ago and can be done for

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: others. And of course, we now know from COVID-19 that our world is so interconnected that a

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: disaster in one part of the world can't be confined to that part and will spread globally. So it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: possible for a few dissidents with expertise in biotech could create a global catastrophe of that

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: kind. And also, I think we need to worry about very large-scale disruption by cyber attacks. In

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: fact, I quote in one of my books a 2012 report from the American Pentagon about the possibility

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: of a state-level cyber attack on the electricity grid in the eastern United States, which is it

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: could happen. And it says at the end of this chapter that this would merit a nuclear response.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: This is a pretty scary possibility. That was 10 years ago. And I think now, what would have needed

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: a state actor then could be done perhaps by a small group empowered by AI. And so there's obviously

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: been an arms race between the cyber criminals and the cyber security people. Not clear which side

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: is winning. But the main point is that as we become more dependent on more integrated systems,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: then we get more vulnerable. And so we have the knowledge, then the misuse of that knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: becomes more and more of a threat. And as I said, bio and cyber are the two biggest concerns.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And if we depend too much on AI and complex systems, then just breakdowns. It may be that

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: they break down. And even if it's an innocent breakdown, then it may be pretty hard to mend it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And just think how much worse the pandemic would have been if we'd lost the internet in the middle

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: of it, which we depended more than ever for communication, everything else on the internet

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: and Zooms and all that. And if that had broken down, that would have made things far worse.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And those are the kinds of threats that we, I think, need to be more energized and politicians

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: need to be more energized to minimize. And one of the things I've been doing in the last year

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: through being a member of our, part of our parliament is sort of, I have to instigate a

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: committee to think more on better preparedness for extreme technological risks and things like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: So they're a big concern in my mind that we've got to make sure that we can benefit from these

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: advances, but safely because the stakes are getting higher and the benefits are getting great, as we

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: know, huge benefits from computers, but also huge downsides as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And one of the things this war in Ukraine has shown, one of the most terrifying things

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: outside of the humanitarian crisis is that, at least for me, I realized

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: that the human capacity to initiate nuclear war is greater than I thought.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: I thought the lessons of the past have been learned. It seems that we need to

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: hang on the brink of nuclear war with this conflict every single day with just one mistake

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: or bad actor or the actual leaders of the particular nations launching a nuclear strike

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: and all hell breaks loose. So then add into that picture cyber attacks and so on, they can

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: can lead to confusion and chaos.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And then out of that confusion,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: calculations are made such that a nuclear launch is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: a nuclear weapon is launched and it's,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: and then you're talking about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: I mean, I don't,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: the directs probably 60, 70% of humans on earth

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: are dead instantly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And then the rest,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: I mean, it's basically 99% of the human population

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: is wiped out in the period of five years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: Well, it may not be that bad,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: but it will be a devastation for civilization, of course.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And of course, you're quite right

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: that this could happen very quickly

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: because of information coming in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And there's hardly enough time for human collected

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: and careful thought.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And there have been recorded cases of false alarms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: There's several where there have been suspected attacks

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: from the other side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And fortunately, they've been realized

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: with false alarms soon enough, but this could happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And there's a new class of threats actually,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: which in our center in Cambridge,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: people are thinking about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: which is that the commander control system

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: of the nuclear weapons and the submarine fleet and all that

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: is now more automated and could be subject to cyber attacks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And that's a new threat, which didn't exist 30 years ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And so I think indeed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: it's really a sort of scary world, I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And it's because things happen faster

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: and human beings aren't in such direct and immediate control

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: because so much is delegated to machines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And also because the world is so much more interconnected,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: then some local event can cascade globally

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: in a way it never could in the past and much faster.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: Yeah, it's a double-edged sword

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: because the interconnectedness brings a higher quality

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: of life across a lot of metrics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: Yeah, it can do, but of course there again,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: I mean, if you think of supply chains

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: where we get stuff from around the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: then one lesson we've learned is that there's a trade-off

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: between resilience and efficiency.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And it's resilient to have an inventory and stock

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: and to depend on local supplies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: whereas the more efficient to have long supply chains.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: But the risk there is that a break in one link in one chain

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: can screw up car production.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: This has already happened in the pandemic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: So there's a trade-off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And there are other examples.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: I mean, for instance, the other thing we learned was

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: that it may be efficient to have 95% of your hospital

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: intensive care beds occupied all the time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: which has been the UK situation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: Whereas to do what the Germans do

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: and always keep 20% of them free for an emergency

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: is really a sensible precaution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And so I think we've probably learned

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: a lot of lessons from COVID-19

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: and they would include rebalancing the trade-off

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: between resilience and efficiency.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: Boy, the fact that COVID-19, a pandemic

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: that could have been a lot, a lot worse,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: brought the world to its knees anyway.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: It could be far worse in terms of its fatality rate

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: Fatality rate, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: So the fact that that, I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: it revealed so many flaws in our human institutions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: Yeah, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And then I think, I'm rather pessimistic

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: because I do worry about the bad actor,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: or the small group who can produce catastrophe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And if you imagine someone with access

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: to the kind of equipment that's available

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: in university labs or industrial labs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: and they could create some dangerous pathogen,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: then even one such person is too many.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And how can we stop that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: Because it's true that you can have regulations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: I mean, academies are having meetings, et cetera,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: about how to regulate these new biological experiments,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: et cetera, make them safe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: But even if you have all these regulations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: then enforcing regulations is pretty hopeless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: We can't enforce the tax laws globally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: We can't enforce the drug laws globally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And so similarly, we can't readily enforce the laws

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: against people doing these dangerous experiments,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: even if all the governments say they should be prohibited.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And so my line on this is that all nations are going

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: to face a big trade-off between three things we value,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: freedom, security, and privacy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And I think different nations will make that choice differently.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: The Chinese would give up privacy

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: and have more, certainly more security, if not more liberty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: But I think in our countries,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: I think we're going to have to give up more privacy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: In the same way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: That's a really interesting trade-off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: But there's also something about human nature here,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: where I personally believe that all humans are capable

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: of good and evil.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And there's some aspect to which we can fight this

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: by encouraging people, incentivizing people

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: towards the better angels of their nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: So in order for a small group of people to create,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: to engineer deadly pathogens,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: you have to have people that for whatever trajectory

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: took them in life, wanting to do that kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And if we can aggressively work on a world

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: that sort of sees the beauty in everybody

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: and encourages the flourishing of everybody

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: in terms of mental health, in terms of meaning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: in terms of all those kinds of things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: that's one way to fight the development

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: of weapons that can lead to atrocities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: Yes, and I completely agree with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And to reduce the reason why people feel embittered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: But of course, we've got a long way to go to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: Because if you look at the present world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: nearly everyone in Africa has reason to feel embittered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: Because their economic development is lagging behind

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: most of the rest of the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: and the prospects of getting out of the poverty trap

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: is rather bleak, especially as the population grows.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: Because for instance, they can't develop

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: like the Eastern Tigers by cheap manufacturing

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: because robots are taking that over.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: So they naturally feel embittered by the inequality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And of course, what we need to have is some sort of

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: mega version of the Marshall Plan that helped Europe

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: in the post-World War II era

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: to enable Africa to develop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: That would be not just an altruistic thing for Europe to do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: but in our interest, because otherwise,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: those in Africa will feel massively disaffected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And indeed, it's a manifestation

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: of the excessive inequalities,

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: the fact that the 2000 richest people in the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: have enough money to double the income

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: of the bottom billion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And that's an indictment of the ethics of the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: And this is where my friend Stephen Pinker and I

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: have had some contact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Martin Rees: Black Holes, Alien Life, Dark Matter, and the Big Bang | Lex Fridman Podcast #305

body.input: I'd like to widen people's awareness of the tremendous time span

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: So quantum computers have two main families of algorithms

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: that are relevant to cryptography.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: One is a Shor's algorithm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: And Shor's algorithm is one that kind of completely breaks

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: the hardness of some specific kinds

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: of mathematical problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: So the one that you've probably heard of

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: is it makes it very easy to factor numbers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: So like figure out kind of what prime factors are

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: that kind of that you need to multiply together

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: to get some number, even if that number is extremely big.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: Shor's algorithm can also be used

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: to break elliptic curve cryptography.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: It can break like any kind of hidden order groups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: It breaks a lot of kind of cryptographic nice things

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: that we're used to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: But the good news is that for every major use of things

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: that Shor's algorithm breaks,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: we already know of quantum proof alternatives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: Now we don't use these quantum proof alternatives yet

body.input: because in many cases,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: they're five to 10 times what's efficient,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: but the crypto industry in general

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: kind of knows that this is coming eventually

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: and switch to that stuff when we have to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: The second algorithm that is relevant to cryptography

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: is Grover's algorithm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: And Grover's algorithm might even be

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: That's basically usually described

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: as solving search problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: But the idea here is that if you have a problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: over the form, find a number that satisfies some property.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: Then if with a classical computer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: you need to try kind of N times before you find a number,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: then with a quantum computer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: you only need to do a square root of N computations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: What's the status of proof of stake

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: as the mechanism that Ethereum moves towards?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: And also how do you move to a different mechanism

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: of consensus within a cryptocurrency?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: So Ethereum 2.0 is a collection of major upgrades

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: that we've wanted to do to Ethereum for quite some time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: The two big ones, one is proof of stake

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: and the other is what we call sharding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: Sharding solves another problem with blockchains,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: which is scalability.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: And what sharding does is it basically says,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: instead of every participant in the network

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: having to personally download and verify every transaction,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: every participant in the network only downloads

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: and verifies a small portion of transactions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: And then you kind of randomly distribute

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: who gets how much work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: And because of how the distribution is random,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: it still has the property that you need a large portion

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: of the entire network to corrupt what's going on

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: inside of any shard,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: but the system is still very redundant and very secure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: That's brilliant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: Like on the technical level, software level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: Proof of stake and sharding are both challenging.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: I'd say sharding is a bit more challenging.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: The reason is that proof of stake is kind of just a change

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: to how the consensus layer works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: Sharding does both that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: but it's also a change to the networking layer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: The reason is that sharding is kind of pointless

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: if at the networking layer, you still do what you do today,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: which is you kind of gossip everything,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: which means that if someone publishes something,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: from on the networking layer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: And so instead we have to have kind of sub networks

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: and the ability to quickly switch between sub networks

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: and other sub networks talk to each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80

body.input: And this is all doable,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80
