metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: For the listener, my guy was holding up a zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You make no money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You still have to pay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You still have to pay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So, and then, oh, let me walk you through what happened to me

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: when we had to try to get the electricity hooked up on our first office.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So we go, they say, oh, first you have to apply, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: like you normally you have to apply.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Then we apply, we pay the money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Remember again, here you have to also go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: This was like, you know, you go to the office and you pay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And then we wait and we wait and we wait.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And when I say we wait, I'm not talking about we waited 24 hours,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: waited 48 hours, a month, two months, three months, four months, five months.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You go, you send your assistant, she goes, she comes back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Well, they say we still need to wait.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: At some point I'm like, I got to go there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So I go there and I asked to speak to the head of the district for, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: and I'm just like going on and on and on and on about how we've been delayed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: This is going to be a problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: We have to produce.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Everything is delayed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And I'm, I risk losing my business.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: We already pre-sold some of these products to our customers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I got to, something needs to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So at some point the gentleman looks at me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: He's like, lady, look over there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I look over there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I see a pile of paper this high.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: We're talking about maybe hundreds of applications.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Each one of them is a single, single, single sheet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Each single sheet is an application for getting the electricity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And he says, do you see that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I said, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And he said, look over there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I look over there to the other side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I see two meters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: He's like, each of these applications needs one of those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: How many do you see?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I said two.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Then I knew I was in trouble.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And then I said, what do I do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And he said, lady, it's not at our level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And I agreed with him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: It was not on his level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But eventually, you know, by now you can tell that I pretty much get what I need because,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: and at that point what I did was not threaten him or anything like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I didn't even pay a bribe or anything,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: but you could see why people pay bribes because when you have a pile like that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: then the only way to advance your file, and that, by the way, happens even at the passport office.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You come, you apply for your passport, which is your right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: They forced us to have passports.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: It's your right as a citizen to have a passport.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And even there, if you want yours to keep going through the process,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: you have to bribe somebody so it can go even the pace it's supposed to go, let alone faster.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So here I'm thinking I have a problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And at that point I did what I do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I talked to him about all the things I was trying to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I explained to him why I'm here, why I'm trying to do this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And even him said, lady, someone like you, you have no reason to even be here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You could be back in America living your life, you don't have to be here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So that, I think, gained a lot of his respect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And I said, if you don't do, if you don't help me with this, I understand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I shouldn't be of a priority or anything like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But I beg you, I beg of you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I need for this to go on this week.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And he said, OK.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: That's how I got my meter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: One of those two meters became mine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So then he said, but we have a problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And I said, what?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: He said, well, the truck, we need a truck to be here to do it because,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: because of where you are from the pole, we need long cable lines to get it all done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But the truck is, I don't know, I don't know where the truck was

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: because they had this one truck for I don't know how many customers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So I go to the mayor of a town with whom I'm quite friends.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But you see, I know people, but it shouldn't be this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So I go to the mayor of a town and I said, Mayor, he happens to have the same name as me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: First, last name, same.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But except he's the ugly one, I'm the pretty one because, you know, he's, you know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: That's so people can tell you apart.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Exactly. I'm the pretty one and he's the whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So I got to the mayor and I'm like, Mayor, I need your help.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You need to help me with this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: He's like, now what? And I explained to him and he's like, OK, you can take the truck from the city hall.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I'll tell the guys that they can allow you to have it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And then they come and then you guys can do this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And then we arrived there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Guess what? I thought I was done, Lex, but I was not done because now the electricity company, by the way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: whom we paid, everything was there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: They've been sitting on our money for nine months by now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Well, we need a ladder long enough to, you know, like one of the super, super professional ladders that normally the electricity companies have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Theirs was in some other village and they didn't know if it was going to be back for another three days or four days.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I said, are you kidding me?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: He's like, no. So I called Mayor again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I'm like, Mayor, do you have a ladder?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And I explained and he said, and that's how I got my electricity hooked up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Otherwise, I probably would still be waiting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So, Lex, you add all of these things together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And also the fact that in my country, by the way, the labor laws are so stringent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Basically, you are married to employees for good or for bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And some people say, oh, no, you're not married for good or bad, except that it will just cost you a lot of time and money to get rid of any of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: It doesn't matter the circumstances.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Do you think I really an entrepreneur really need to hear something like that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You know, the head of the ILO, I had an argument with him at the UN and I said to him, listen, and you listen to me very well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: The reason if you want to protect employees as you claim, everything you're doing is to protect employees.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: A, you know better for human being than I am in terms of wanting to make sure that people are treated right and fairly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But last time I checked, Google, for example, is not offering their employees chef cooked meals, super healthy, anything they want, feeding them for morning till evening,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: having some babysitters, having child care on site, all of these perks that come on top of really cozy salaries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: It did not happen because you, the ILO, told them you have to do this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: It happened because there are enough jobs created around that now you're in an employee's market and employers have to fall all over themselves to attract the best talent among us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: That's how it's done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And not with your nonsense that you're imposing me right now, which the only results you're going to get, like in my country,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: do you know what we have to show for all of these, the fact that Senegalese employees are the most protected employees on paper in the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: We're one of the 25 poorest countries in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: That's what it got us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So let's try to untangle this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So there's a system in place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: There's a momentum with that system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Like you said, lady, it's not my level, which is for somebody who grew up in the Soviet Union,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: at least echoes some of the same sounds I heard from people I knew there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: It's kind of this helpless feeling like, well, this is just part of the system, this gigantic bureaucracy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And the corruption that happens is just like the only way to get around to get anything done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And so the corruption grows.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Maybe could you speak to the corruption?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Is there is to what degree is there corruption in Senegal and Africa?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And how do we fix it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So when you say to which degree is there corruption, I will respond to you the same.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I respond to people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I say, yeah, we have corruption and it's almost as bad as in Chicago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So now what I want people to understand when it comes to corruption,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: it's because we are misguided with corruption.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: We think corruption is the root cause of problems when corruption is simply a symptom of a deeper root problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: In this case, if you make the laws so senseless, meaning, let me give you an example of senseless laws.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Every time I have to import something in my country, I have a business.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: We're making lip balms in this case and other skincare products.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Some ingredients I'm able to find in the country at the standard that I need in order to remain competitive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Because, for example, our products are sold in the Whole Foods market.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You can understand it's a pretty sophisticated and really, you know, they don't just put anybody on the shelves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But the thing is, it means that on the other end, my inputs has to be right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So out of those, some, we have seven ingredients, seven items that need to come from abroad to go into the making of this product.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Some packaging and some raw material.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But guess what?

body.input: Money is suspicious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You know, success is suspicious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So at some point, my husband and I just felt like our friends actually were maybe thinking that we're maybe some drug dealers or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So we just stopped because it just was not flowing anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And so, so yes, in America, I found I found this this entrepreneurial spirit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But then I was able to link it with something that I'm very familiar with in my country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: See, back home in Senegal, I'm part of this, you know, you have what we call the moored.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I'm a moored.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And what it is is one of the four brotherhoods in Senegal, mooredism is the most influential of them and the biggest one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And us, it's all about entrepreneurship as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I mean, of course, there's the whole religious part.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And but our mantra is pray as if you will die tomorrow and work as if you will never die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And the way we say the way somebody will say that somebody passed away, we say somebody has retired.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Somebody has retired from their work. Right. Beautiful. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So so so I think it's funny because in in that community, we're very much entrepreneurial, you know, left to our own devices.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: We're entrepreneurial. But then what happens is the minute people start going to they're being educated through the education system, you know, like the French, especially in the system, but tend to breed more like, you know, the French bureaucrat mindset.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Then you can see all the entrepreneurial mindset kind of starting to to dwindle down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So it's kind of very interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So in a way, America helped me reunite with that side of my of my roots, where America tells me reinforces that side of my roots and also gives me more tools to practice that side of my roots, if that makes any sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Through all of that, that's what brings out the heart of a cheetah, which I think is a beautiful, beautiful thing that encapsulate that whole trajectory, which I think is the best possible answer anyone could give.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: It makes me want to really think about who I am, because you really have brought together so many cultures within yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Like just talking to you makes you feel like we are just all one people. Because at the end we are. At the end we are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And, you know, when you come from at the end we are and also I think for me, if people can take anything from my story, it's at the end of the day, I am very clear about it and I'm all for harmony among people and among among us peoples.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: If we can accept that we're all, I know this sounds so cliche, but for me it's so true, that we're all humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You know, when I left Senegal, when I was about to leave Senegal for the first time and to go to Europe to be reunited with my parents, because now they had emigrated and things were going to be fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And I was going to be, things were stable for them. Now they're like, it's time to be reunited with her.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: They brought me over, but before I left Senegal, my grandma sat me down. She actually, she lowered herself down to my level and she said, she said, Magat, you're about to go to this place where most people will not look like you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And most people speak a language that's going to be different from yours.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And you're going to realize that all the kids are going to school and you've never been to school, because you know I was, like I said, a free range kid and I was just living my life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And she said, but I don't want for any of that, and she showed her words, she said, I don't want for any of that to intimidate you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: She said, you can be impressed by some of it if you want, but no intimidation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And she said, because the fact that they might be different from you, yeah, they're going to have a different skin color from you, but it is still human skin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You're human, they're human.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And she said, this language you're going to speak, it's a different language from yours, but it is still a language that humans speak.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You're human, they're human, therefore you can speak it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And lastly, they have gone to school. Going to school is what little humans do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You're a little human, so you'll be just fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And I went and grandma was right, right? She was right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And that helped me. And I think when you internalize that so early on, it just makes you belong to the human family that you're part of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I am part of a human family. And I would have no problem going to Russia, for example, let's take, and be totally open.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Maybe don't go right now, but.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: No, not now. Maybe not now, you're right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Or at least don't bring weed if you go on the plane.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: No, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, yeah, right. That girl, I don't know what she was thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But no, so, but what I'm trying to say, Lex, is I feel like I can go anywhere in the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: including some of the most unfriendly places in the world to someone like me, because there are places like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And yet I know, I know that somehow, somewhere, someone will take care of me. Someone will help me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: When I first came to this country, I came as a tourist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And but, you know, you had this amazing family who had a business, a family business in Indiana, Columbus, Indiana.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: The Wences, Carolyn Eldon Wences, I owe them everything that I have in this country, that I am in this country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: They are Americans in the mid-America from a place that most other Americans would maybe look down on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: because, you know, and some people would be like, oh, you're going to this place where they have more churches and cows than people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You know, that type of behavior, because, you know, the elite, the coastal elites.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But it is in the Midwest that I found that I, black, young women coming out of nowhere, found support.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: They all rallied around me. I didn't even come from the same faith as they are from.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Yet the whole church rallied around me to find me an apartment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: My host family found me, got me a job, and it was not a pity job.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: They were like, we need, we are in serious needs of getting our accounting under control and our marketing and all of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And I had to catch up years of accounting, like, to the cent and come up with marketing, all of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And I did it way faster than they thought I would ever be able to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: At some point, they look at me and they're like, look, there is a future for you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And we are too small for that future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And now we could be, we could be selfish and keep you here with us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And we wouldn't want nothing more than that, because really, they're like my parents to this day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I just came back from seeing them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And they said, but there's so much more for you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And we don't have it. So we want you to go and find out what it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And that's eventually when I, you know, because something was brewing up in San Francisco when I say I left my heart in San Francisco,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: because, you know, my, my, the man would become my husband.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: We went to the same business school in France, but then he was older than me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So he had come to San Francisco and started a business there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And it just looked like there was something there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And Carol was like, you've got to go to San Francisco and find out with Emmanuel what's going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So I went and I left my heart in San Francisco. I came back and I'm like, okay, I'm leaving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Here's the keys to my apartment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But I'm like, I'm out of here. So, no, but Carol, so this is it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: This is what I'm saying, especially in these times when this country loves to dwell on, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: you're bad because you have this skin color.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Here are people with a completely different skin color than mine, completely different faith than mine,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: yet embraced me, protected me, paid for my visa, you know, for my lawyer, for my H1B, everything,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: and also played emotional support for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And no one, no one asked them to do that. They didn't have to do it. They didn't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So what I'm saying is, and this has been the story of my life, everywhere I go,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: regardless of the hostility around me, you bet you have at this always, always going to be somebody

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: who shows up for you and somebody who is at the extremes, at the antipods of where you are and who you are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And that tells me something. In the end, we are good people. Most people are good people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And there's so much power to that, the internalizing of this idea that we're all just human.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And there's human kindness all around us. I've seen it a lot where people internalize that

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: and they're able to walk lightly amidst hate and walk past it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And it doesn't stick to them in a way that they build resentment and it paralyzes them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: If they internalize the world as human, they can be in the, just like you said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: in the worst places in the world for them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And someone, somewhere that human magic and touch is there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Yeah, it will find them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: It will find them. Yeah, yeah. And you know, the other thing too, Lex, is, especially in these times we're walking in,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: it is to remind yourself, I think this is where we all are called to practice more courage. I call it courage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: It's the courage to show up with curiosity, with empathy and with love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: To me, those three are the antidote to pretty much anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Curiosity, empathy and love. In the face of fear, can you show up with curiosity?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: In the face of hate, can you say, I'm going to engage with love, even if I'm scared to death

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: and even if I'm pissed off to death by this. But can you do that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: In the face of just like, you know, judgment or whatever, can you show up with empathy?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And I had just found that when you try to do that, you engage very different parts of your brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: That's proven by the way by the brain scientists, but you also can feel it in your body that you engage in

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: very different parts of your soul. And so I try myself, I'm not always good at it, but it's a practice

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: that I try to honor, which is curiosity, empathy and love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: As I told you offline, those, I agree with you 100% on that. But there is, you know, when you go to Ukraine

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: and you can say, you can speak about the power of love, but when you lose your family, when you lose your home,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: all you have in your heart is hate. Even if you know it, you're not supposed to have it. You still, all you have is hate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So sometimes it's a very human thing to have resentment, to have hate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But it is about trying not to stay there. And it's okay if it takes you years, but it is about trying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And I mean the word trying. It is about trying not to stay there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Let me ask you about some of the things you see in this country from your perspective of everywhere you've been in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: What do you think about the Black Lives Matter movement here in America that does struggle with the role of skin color today

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: and throughout the history of this country, maybe even throughout the history of the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Well, Black Lives Matter has been a very hard one for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Because do Black Lives Matter, those three words together in that order, what they mean?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: They mean everything, because Black Lives do matter, as any other lives do matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But I know in this case why they say Black Lives Matter, because some of the context we have had.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Now, while I agree with the principles that Black Lives Matter, I have a big problem with the organization and what it stands for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: When I have an organization that pretends to want to stand for Black Lives to matter, yet you are self-proclaimed Marxist socialists, I pause.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Why? I pause and then I'm like, have we learned nothing? Have we learned nothing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And the reason why I say that, Lex, is because 60 some years ago, it started before even 60 some years ago,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Black people in this case, I'm talking about the African people, I'm talking about the Black Africans

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: who would go on to really cement this concept of African emancipation and African liberation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And here I'm taking us back to 1945. They had four of them before that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311
