metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I'm so proud of them and the young people, especially.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And, you know, you would look at them and you know, somebody said sometimes one day and it was so true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: They said, you know, we've seen poverty other places, but here it is just maybe somebody doesn't have money, but they have dignity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And it's true. Yeah. So everything else we can handle and we will handle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You have to mark my word for this. This is going to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And our youth is amazing. You should see them so full of creativity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And it doesn't matter. You know, you were telling me what makes you different.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Many things makes us all different. You know, the Rwandans are very different from the West Africans that we are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Rwandans, for example, never dance with their hips. They dance more like, you know, with this part of a body.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: West Africans hips. Us, it's hips all over the place all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And it's, you know, more jumping stuff like that. In Rwanda, you feel it's more like, you know, I mean, they remind me more of ballet, you know, the ballet thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Rwandans have a sense where, you know, they don't eat, you know, so much in public. It's not very well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: It's something you do. Us, we are the West Africans. We like to be loud.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: We're almost like the Italians of the continent. And then the Rwandans are more like, you know, the Swiss of the country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: It's like Switzerland. I mean, we're so different from one group to another. Then you go to the Congo and you see these guys.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: They're so crazy. The way they dress. I mean, les sapeurs. So we are a very different bunch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But you know what I love about us, what I love about my people?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: We are the manifestation of what resiliency means.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And so everything we need is there. Everything we need is there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I will say that there is nothing wrong with the seed. Everything that's wrong with us is that pot that we put around us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So we're tired of being bonsai people. We need to be the tallest trees in the forest that we were designed to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And that can be fixed. And that can be fixed. And that's the beauty of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And that's why I am so, I'm almost dizzy with, I get dizzy with hope.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I know my history. I know my economics, my fellow humans and all of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And we know that there's an unfailing recipe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And when it comes to that recipe, we have the hardest part of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So one missing ingredient, which is the free markets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: As we go around and talk and people start to understand and each country tries to figure out, okay, where do we go there from here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I know that I will die with my continent having taken the right shift, the right turn.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I have to see where it ends because I cannot in my wildest dream imagine where it's going to end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But I know it's going to be, yeah. So all my only job is to get this message out and then let my people do with it what they want to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Yeah, the scale of impact is just boundless. It's kind of cool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I mean, you know, sometimes we think about individual problems and how do we solve them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: We look up to certain individuals like the, I don't know, Steve Jobs and Elon Musk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But it's so much more powerful to just without knowing what they will do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: give the freedom to millions, to hundreds of millions of people to do whatever the hell they're going to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Can you imagine? Can you just imagine?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: It's truly, truly exciting. So in that sense, the work you're doing, it's unimaginable the kind of impact it would have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Now, going back to that hard moment, this dark place you went in, in your mind, in your personal life story, you lost your husband.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: What gave you strength during that time?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: What were the places you went to your mind in terms of personal struggle, in terms of maybe even depression or these kinds of struggles?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I think for me, when my person passed away, I went to maybe my friends could see what was going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Maybe they couldn't. I don't know. But on the surface, I looked like I was fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But what happened is the only thing I think that kept me around as I thought about it was the job to be done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: These women relied on me and I was no longer free. I did not own myself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And they said it in those words, you don't own yourself anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And it was true, but it helped me because I was able to, you know, sometimes whatever it takes to keep you around, whatever it takes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And that's what I would tell people who feel like they can't just push one more push and they think they need to end it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: At that point, whatever it takes, just stick around for one more second because the next second, you know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So I stuck around because of duty. I felt a very strong sense of duty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: My duty was in this case, I think stronger than my pain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I don't know how that was possible, but it was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And I just pushed my grief under the rug for years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: For years, I worked like a mad lady.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I would travel, I would do three states in three days, landing at two in the morning around five or six,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: going to ride along with our distributors because it was beverage and just keep going and have all of this energy and look like everything is fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But what happened was just like I was focused on the job to be done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And sometimes it is OK to do that. At least for me, it was my safety.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You know, like when you're in the water and you're about to sink and they throw you that round thing, I don't know how you call it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You know that...

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: The thing that keeps you afloat, you mean?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Yes, the floater.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Yeah, whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Listen, between the two of us, we're still terrible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: We're bad. So they sent you...

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I know exactly what you mean.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Exactly, right? So you understand me. So they sent you that thing and you just... I was just hanging on to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: My life depended on this thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So these women, they carried me. They carried me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And with time, things are moving forward.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And at some point I went into a really, really deep depression and I went into a very dark place, even darker than the one I think I came from.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Because by that time, I had worked for years on this company and now some other things were happening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And around that time, it's also when I was discovering a lot of what we talked about today, about what makes a country rich.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And for me to understand that my network, I was very much into a left-oriented network.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And to just start to see all of this, I tried to address it to realize that many of these people would prefer go running for the hills

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: than accept for a moment that maybe capitalism might be part of a solution when many of them were involved in capitalism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So that was a hard time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: At some point, I was... Yeah, so many things were happening around that time that basically shook up everything for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: One, it's hard to talk about because it's very personal and the person that I was having a problem with passed away last year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And I'm one to always say, leave the dead alone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So because of that, I won't speak about it, but there too, having a major fallout with somebody who was like a fabber figure for me, somebody that I completely trusted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And so at some point, you just ask yourself, was my whole life built on a lie? Right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And then you're confused and then you become confused.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And then at some point you lose 90% of your friends because of, ideologically speaking, it doesn't work anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Then you just wonder, have I been asleep this whole time?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And then you start to wonder, remember when you asked me, who am I?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: At some point, Lex, I literally was like a candle in the wind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I felt like I was a candle in the wind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And it was very hard to come back from that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And the few people I talked to about this, they have a hardest time understanding or even believing it because they're like, you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I'm like, yes, me. I used to be a candle in the wind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: What got you out? What made you overcome that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: My current husband. My current husband.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Love?

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Love. See? When I tell you love is the answer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: He came with love, but he also came with really helping me figure out the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So what Michael, because that's who we're talking about, Michael Strong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: This guy must be special.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: He's so special. He's so special.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: So you have no idea how special he is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But, you know, Michael, the reason why I have such love, respect and admiration for my husband, I'll never say it enough,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: is because actually it's one of those relationships that got built based on intellect first.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: You see, at some point I was in the position where I could start a foundation after having built my first business.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And all I wanted was an ability to power as many, especially women, African women entrepreneurs like me a few years ago,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: before then, to do something like I was able to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Bring back to the world some really cool aspects of our culture built into a really cool brand, 21st century type.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: That's what I wanted to do, because the more I could promote women like that

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: and put steam behind them, and the more my dream and vision for a respected Africa,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: prosperous Africa would happen, back then that's what I wanted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And around me, this was also part of the whole crisis of ideologies I had back then.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: Everybody was like, well, we should be just doing grants.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And I knew that my people didn't need grants.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: They didn't need like a handout.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: They don't want your charity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I didn't want charity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I wanted someone who could work with me on my accounting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I wanted somebody who could help me brainstorm marketing-wise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I wanted somebody or I needed to raise money to pay my research and development guy

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: to help me take the juices from my grandma's recipe to something that can be shelf stable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I needed coaching.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: These are all the things that I needed to make my dream happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I didn't want you to give me some crap for free.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: That's not what I want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: I just want to be able to build my business with all the things that business building needs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And so that's what I wanted to do and it's what was needed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And so Michael, somebody found out about what I was doing because back in the days

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: in San Francisco they would write a lot about me and everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: And so Michael along with John Mackey, the founder of Whole Foods Market,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: they had a nonprofit called Flow and it's all about human flourishing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: They want for people, everybody to get this choice, this ability to be able to get to a point in their life

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: where they're in complete flow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: It's Michael, Michael is the only one who can say that last name.

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: But you know, the whole concept of flow, when you're in a state of flow,

metadata.title: Podcast: Magatte Wade: Africa, Capitalism, Communism, and the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #311

body.input: you're basically doing what you're supposed to do, the way you're supposed to do it,

body.input: Since we're talking about the evolutionary history of a virus,

body.input: let's zoom back out and look at the evolution of proteins.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: I glanced at this 2010 Nature paper on the, quote,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: ongoing expansion of the protein universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And then it kind of implies and talks about that proteins started with a common ancestor,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: which is kind of interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: It's interesting to think about even just the first organic thing that started life on Earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And from that, there's now, what is it, 3.5 billion years later,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: there's now millions of proteins and they're still evolving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And that's in part one of the things that you're researching.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: Is there something interesting to you about the evolution of proteins

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: from this initial ancestor to today?

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: Is there something beautiful and insightful about this long story?

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: So I think if I were to pick a single keyword about protein evolution,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: I would pick modularity, something that we talked about in the beginning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And that's the fact that the proteins are no longer considered as a sequence of letters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: There are hierarchical complexities in the way these proteins are organized.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And these complexities are actually going beyond the protein sequence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: It's actually going all the way back to the gene, to the nucleotide sequence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And so, again, these protein domains, they are not only functional building blocks,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: they are also evolutionary building blocks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And so what we see in the later stages of evolution,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: once these stable, structurally and functionally building blocks were discovered,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: they essentially, those domains stay as such.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: So that's why if you start comparing different proteins,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: you will see that many of them will have similar fragments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And those fragments will correspond to something that we call protein domain families.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And so they are still different because you still have mutations

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: and the different mutations are attributed to diversification of the function

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: of these protein domains.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: However, you very rarely see the evolutionary events

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: that would split this domain into fragments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: Because once you have the domain split,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: you actually can completely cancel out its function

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: or at the very least you can reduce it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And that's not efficient from the point of view of the cell function.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: So the protein domain level is a very important one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: Now, on top of that, if you look at the proteins,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: so you have these structural units and they carry out the function.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: But then much less is known about things that connect these protein domains,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: something that we call linkers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And those linkers are completely flexible parts of the protein

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: that nevertheless carry out a lot of function.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: It's like little tails, little heads.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: So we do have tails, so they're called termini, C and N termini.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: So these are things right on one and another ends of the protein sequence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: So they are also very important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: So they attribute it to very specific interactions between the proteins.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: But you're referring to the links between domains.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: That connect the domains.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And apart from the simple perspective,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: if you have a very short domain, you have a very short linker,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: you have two domains next to each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: They are forced to be next to each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: If you have a very long one, you have the domains that are extremely flexible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And they carry out a lot of sort of spatial reorganization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: But on top of that, just this linker itself, because it's so flexible,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: it actually can adapt to a lot of different shapes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And therefore, it's a very good interactor

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: when it comes to interaction between this protein and other protein.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: So these things also evolve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And they, in a way, have different sort of laws,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: the driving laws that underlie the evolution

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: because they no longer need to preserve certain structure,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: unlike protein domains.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And so on top of that, you have something that is even less studied.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And this is something that attributes to the concept of alternative splicing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: So alternative splicing, it's a very cool concept.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: It's something that we've been fascinated about for over a decade in my lab

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: and trying to do research with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: So typically, a simplistic perspective is that one gene is equal to one protein product.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: So you have a gene, you transcribe it and translate it, and it becomes a protein.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: In reality, when we talk about eukaryotes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: especially sort of more recent eukaryotes that are very complex,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: the gene is no longer equal to one protein.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: It actually can produce multiple functionally active protein products.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And each of them is called an alternatively spliced product.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: The reason it happens is that if you look at the gene,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: it actually has also blocks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And the blocks, some of which, and essentially it goes like this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: So we have a block that will later be translated, we call it exon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: Then we'll have a block that is not translated, cut out, we call it intron.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: So we have exon, intron, exon, intron, etc., etc., etc.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And sometimes you can have dozens of these exons and introns.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: So what happens is during the process when the gene is converted to RNA,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: we have things that are cut out, the introns that cut out,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: and exons that now get assembled together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And sometimes we will throw out some of the exons,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: and the remaining protein product will become different.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: So now you have fragments of the protein that are no longer there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: They were cut out with the introns.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: Sometimes you will essentially take one exon and replace it with another one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: So there's some flexibility in this process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: So that creates a whole new level of complexity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: Is this random though?

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: It's not random.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And this is where I think now the appearance of this modern single cell

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: and before that tissue level sequencing, next-generation sequencing techniques,

body.input: or in response to certain developmental stage of a cell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And this is an incredibly complex layer that also undergoes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Dmitry Korkin: Evolution of Proteins, Viruses, Life, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #153

body.input: And you just look at yourself. What is this? Why do I have the capacity to suffer?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: Why? Why? All these kinds of why questions that don't have answers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: Speaking of which, let me ask you a why question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: The biggest ridiculous one. What do you think is the meaning of life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: Having with this book studied the incredible, beautiful biology of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: The components, the engineering components, they make up this human body.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: But when you look at the entirety of it, what is it? Why? Why are we here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: Sometimes, probably more often than not, feel like the question of why is a trick of the human brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: And outside of our thoughts, there is no why. Why is not something that's in the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: It's just this trick happening inside our brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: So why is a game that the human brain plays on itself?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: And then the reality of life doesn't have why's.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: I do wonder if asking why is sort of an evolutionary adaptation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: Like maybe hunting, gathering. Why does this plant grow there and not there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: Why do I see the same deer tracks by the same tree every three days?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: Why is this? Why is that? Why does this plant make me vomit and that plant doesn't?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: I guess those why's are very practical and oriented towards survival.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: But then obviously, we not only use why, we use it to maybe hunt better, gather better, survive better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: But then we sort of extrapolate it into these unanswerable questions about why.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: Like why does life exist?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: It's possible that they're not unanswerable in the long arc of science and history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: We're just striving for the really difficult questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: Right now, we just don't know much about anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: And so we're striving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: But there's long...

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: So most of human history, you were asking why questions for which we now have very precise answers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: including with biology and physics and all those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: And maybe the why is this cutting edge of science, of the explorer of the curiosity of the human mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: Like man's search for meaning is the ultimate driver of the why.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: And it's almost like it could be an evolutionary adaptation of asking exceptionally hard why questions that will never get answered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: So you should always have...

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: It's like a queue. It's a stack of questions, why questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: And that thing should never come to the bottom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: It should always be striving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: And that's useful for humans to come up with better and better ways of survival.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: And maybe in a bigger perspective for the universe to figure out something about itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

metadata.title: Podcast: Jonathan Reisman: The Human Body - From Sex & Sperm to Hands & Heart | Lex Fridman Podcast #297

body.input: The following is a conversation with Bishop Robert Barron,

body.input: founder of Word on Fire

body.input: on the beauty and wisdom within Catholicism, Christianity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: This is the Alex Friedman podcast.

body.input: in the description.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And now, dear friends, here's Bishop Robert Barron.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Let's start with the big question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Who is God?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: According to Christianity, according to Catholicism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: who's God?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: I'll give you Thomas Aquinas' definition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: God is ipsum, essay, subsistence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: God is the subsistent act of to be itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Another way to state that in Aquinas

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: is God is that reality, unique, absolutely unique,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: in which essence and existence coincide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: To be God is to be to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Those are all ways of talking about what we mean by God.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: They are kind of nomic and that's on purpose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: There's almost a Zen koan kind of equality

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: about the way we talk about God.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: I'm saying something that's substantive,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: but it's more in like a via negativa mode.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: It's more like what God is not

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: because there's nothing in the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: that would correspond to those descriptions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So anything in the world would be a being of some type

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: or an event of some type, some particular mode of existence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And God is not an entity in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: I would say that's the fundamental mistake

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: that atheists old and new make all the time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: is they think of God as a big being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: When Aquinas says that God is not in any genus,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: even the genus of being,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: it's one of the strangest remarks in the whole tradition,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: but it's really interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So you say, well, at the very least,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: God must be a being, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And Aquinas' answer is no, he's not in the genus of being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So we talk about God being beyond being and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: To say in God essence and existence coincide

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: is to say God's very nature is to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And that can't be true of any contingent thing in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So what I'm doing there is I'm gesturing

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: the way the tradition does toward God,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: using language that's at the same time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: philosophically precise and nomic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: It's both accurate, it's true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: God, essence and existence coincide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: What God is is the same as God's active to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: But now what does that mean?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: I'm not quite sure because nothing

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: in our ordinary experience corresponds to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Everything in our experience is a being of some type.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So it's existence received according

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: to the mode of some essence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: That's not true of God, which is why

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: he can't be found in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And that's, as I say, the fundamental mistake is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: oh, I guess theists are those that believe there's this

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: being alongside the other beings in the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And then atheists say, oh no, there is no such being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And that's precisely wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: That's just a category error.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Dawkins, I think, cites Bertrand Russell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: To the effect that proving the non-existence of God

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: is a bit like proving the non-existence

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: of a China teapot orbiting between Earth and Mars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: No, that's precisely what God is not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Some entity that's sort of hidden

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: among the other entities of the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: God is the reason why there's a contingent realm at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: That's the way to put it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: In more theological language,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: God's the creator of all things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So if God is outside of our world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: is it possible for us to visualize,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: to comprehend, to know God?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Not utterly, of course.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And I would say our knowledge begins always in this world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: begins in ordinary experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: But I think we can, through metaphysical analysis,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: through philosophical reasoning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: can come to some knowledge of a reality

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: which is transcendent to our experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So we gesture toward it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: I always like Aquinas who says the language about God

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: that we use is analogical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So it's not univocal, meaning what I say about that can

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: or about this bottle, I can say about God.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: No, that makes God an entity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: At the same time, it's not simply equivocal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So if I say, well, that thing is and God is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: I mean totally different things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: No, no, I mean something analogous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So to be God is to be to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So the real meaning of being is the being of God.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: The being of that thing or this thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: or the being of galaxies or subatomic particles

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: would be analogous to God's manner of being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So on that basis, I can make some statements.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: I can theorize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And even at the limit, as you suggest, I can visualize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So we have metaphors for God

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: and the Bible is replete with those, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So God is a rock, you know, God's like a lion,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: God's like this and that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Or the Bible will sometimes imagine God

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: as a human being walking around, you know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Now only the crudest fundamentalism would say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So that's the only way I can go through the list of,

body.input: you know, from sports and Boy Scouts, et cetera.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And that's been proven again and again.

body.input: So I would tie it more to that.

body.input: I wouldn't tie it to celibacy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So the challenge, of course, is all kinds of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: you said institutional cover.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: There's all kinds of institutions that cover for-

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: People that don't, that do evil onto the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: that do sinful things onto the world.

body.input: But there's something about the church,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: which is the, as an organism is supposed to be

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And it breaks people's hearts to see this kind of,

body.input: even a small amount, this kind of thing happen

body.input: within the church.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: It wakes you up to the cruelty,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Like it's back to the question of why do bad things happen

body.input: to good people?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Do you have an answer to that question?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: I can gesture toward it using rather abstract language,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: which is true enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304
