metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: but it's naming it truthfully enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And it goes back to Augustine,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: which is God permits evil to bring about a greater good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Now again, I know how unsatisfying

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: that sort of spare austere language can sound,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: but it gets us off the horns of a dilemma.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Aquinas, when he lays out a question,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: he always has the objections first.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So is there a God?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Well, objection one, objection two, objection three.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And he's really, talk about steel manning and argument.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Aquinas is great at that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: One of the really steel manned arguments,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: is that the right grammatical form?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: One of the, what's the past participle about the steel man?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: But one of the best arguments, he formulates it this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: If one of two contraries be infinite,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: the other would be altogether destroyed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And as example from his medieval physics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: he goes, if there were an infinite heat,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: there'd be no cold, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: But God has described as infinitely good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Therefore, if God exists, there should be no evil,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: but there is evil, therefore God does not exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: That's a darn good argument.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: That's a really persuasive argument.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And I think, and I've done this for a long time

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: in apologetics and in sort of higher philosophy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: that's the best argument against God.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: But here's something, before I press head with it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: something I find really interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: I think the three best arguments against God,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: all come from within the religious tradition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Namely, the book of Job.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So Job, he's great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: I mean, he's a great guy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: He does everything right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: He's God's great servant,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: and he's punished in every possible way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: He has every possible suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Aquinas' argument from the summa,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: and then to your friend and mine, Dostoevsky.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: I think in the Brothers Karamazov,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Ivan's argument when he's trying to wreck the faith

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: of Ali Khrushchev,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: and it's these examples drawn,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: they think from Dostoevsky,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: from the headlines of his own time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: of the most abject cruelty to children,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: like an innocent child being made to suffer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: How in God's name could that happen

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: if God exists and he's all good?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So I get it, but see the book of Job,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Thomas Aquinas, Dostoevsky,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: these are all profoundly believing people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: It's like when I hear Stephen Fry,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: the famously atheist writer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: he will bring out this argument with great authority.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: He does.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Of children with bone cancer

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: and worms that go into the eyes of children

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: and blind them before they kill them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: But he's been preceded by the author of Job,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Thomas Aquinas and Dostoevsky,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: who stood right, think of Job, in the whirlwind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: He stands there in the whirlwind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So you can't blame the Christian tradition

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: for not dealing with this problem,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: for like brushing it under the carpet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: I mean, it has stood in the whirlwind of this problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: It's still a difficult problem to deal with,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: that there's all this cruelty of the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: There's a lot of example through history,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: just in my own family history with my family,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: my own family history with the Soviet Union,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: with Stalin, the atrocities that Stalin has brought on

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: to the people of the Soviet Union

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: throughout the 20th century is nearly immeasurable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And yet, when you look at the entirety of human history,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: you will see progress, not just the Soviet Union,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: but the entirety of the civilization

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: throughout the 20th century.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And Stalin has a role to play.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: There's a dark aspect to somehow evil

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: helps us make progress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And I don't know how to put that into calculation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: On the local scale, I want to alleviate suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: I'm probably a heavily lean pacifist,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: not out of weakness, but out of strength.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: But man, it does seem that history is sprinkled with evil

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: and that evil does somehow nudge us towards good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Yes, sometimes we can see it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And that's where the idea comes from,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: that evil's permitted to bring about some greater good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And we can sometimes really see it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Can we always see it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: No, in fact, typically we don't see it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: But now you bring another factor into this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: which is the difference between our minds and God's mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So our minds, I mean, look,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: even they're remarkably capacious,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: but they take in a tiny, tiny, tiny swath of space and time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And even like our eyes can like take in so much

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: of the light spectrum and these little ape sensorium

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: that we have that could just take in

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: a little tiny bit of reality, really.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: How are we ever in a position to say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: oh no, there's no possible good

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: that would ever come from that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Even the greatest evil that, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Dostoevsky and that can conjure up and Stephen Fry,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: still, how could we have the arrogance to say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: I know there's no good that could ever come from that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: I know there's no morally justifiable reason

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Because I think that's hubris to the nth degree

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: for us to say that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: And that's the assumption behind this claim

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: that God can permit evil to bring about a greater good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: Now God understands it, but we're like little kids,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: you know, like a four year old

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: and their parents make a decision and we say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: what in the, why in the world would you do this to me?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: This is my pastoral experience, years ago,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: I forgot what it was, but he had to undergo surgery, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: So after the surgery, he's in great pain,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: this poor kid, this three year old kid,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: and the dad was there with him, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: holding his hand and you know, and the son,

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

body.input: he's looking at me like, what gives here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Bishop Robert Barron: Christianity and the Catholic Church | Lex Fridman Podcast #304

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I think it totally fits in and it's this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: there's nothing irrational about what we believe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: especially those principles which we hold the most dear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I'm merely trying to say that there's a calculus,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: there's one calculus over here that says

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Russia's more powerful than it was 20 years ago

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and even 10 years ago and Ukraine is not,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and it's asking for something,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and there's an incentive to give that up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: That's obvious, there's an incentive to comply.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: But my understanding is many of these post-Soviet republics

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: have appeased, right, which is what we call compromise

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: when we disagree with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: They've, all of these other peoples

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: in the Russian sphere of influence have not stood up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And Russians, many Russians have tried to stand up

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and they've been beaten down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And now people have, we'll see,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: but people have not been standing up very much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And so lots of people are cowed

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and lots of people have appeased

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and lots of people hear that speech

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and think I would like to do that but don't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And so, and my point is that sadly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: we live in a world where a lot of people

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: get stepped on by tyrants and empire and whatnot

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and don't rise up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And so I think we could admire,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: especially when they stand up for these reasons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And I think we can admire Churchill for that reason.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I think we could, that's why we admire

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: the leaders of the American Revolution and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: But it doesn't always happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And I don't actually know why.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: But I don't think it's irrational.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I think it's just, it's something,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: it's about a set of values and it's hard to predict.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And it was hard for,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Putin might not have been out of line

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and thinking just like everybody else

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: in my sphere of influence, they're gonna roll over too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And I should mention, because we haven't,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: that a lot of this calculation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: from an objective point of view,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: you have to include the United States and NATO

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: into the pressure they apply into the region.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: That said, I care little about leaders

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: that do cruel things onto the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: They lead to a lot of suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: But I still believe that the Russian people

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and the Ukrainian people are great people that stand up

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and I admire people that stand up

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and are willing to give their life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And I think Russian people are very much that too,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: especially when the enemy is coming

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: for your home over the hill.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Sometimes standing up to an authoritarian regime

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: is difficult because you don't know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: it's not a monster that's attacking your home directly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: It's kind of like the boiling of a lobster

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: It's a slow control of your mind and the population.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And our minds get controlled even in the West

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: by the media, by the narratives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: It's very difficult to wake up one day

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and to realize sort of what people call red-pilled.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: It's to see that they're,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: maybe the thing I've been told all my life is not true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And at every level,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: that's a thing very difficult to do in North Korea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: The more authoritarian the regime,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: the more difficult it is to see.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Maybe this idea that I believe

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: that I was willing to die for is actually evil.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: It's very difficult to do for Americans, for Russians,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: for Ukrainians, for Chinese, for Indians, for Pakistanis,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: for everybody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I think thinking about this Ukrainian,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: whether you want to call it nobility or intransigence

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: or whatever is key.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I think the authoritarianness of Russia

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and Putin's control or the control of his cabal

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: is the other thing I would really point to

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: as what's going on here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And if you ask me big picture,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: what do I think is the fundamental cause

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: of most violence in the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I think it's unaccountable power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I think, in fact, for me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: an unaccountable power is the source of underdevelopment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: It's the source of pain and suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: It's the source of warfare.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: It's basically the root source of most of our problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And in this particular case,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: it's also one of our buckets in the sense that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: like, why, what is it that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: why did Russia ask these things?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Like, well, was democracy in Ukraine

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: No.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Was capitalism, is NATO, is whatever,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: is this a threat to average Russians?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: No, it's a threat to the apparatus of political control

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and economic control that Putin and cronies

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and this sort of group of people that rule,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And so they had to ask the Ukraine to be neutral

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: or to give up NATO or to have a puppet government

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: or whatever they were seeking to achieve

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and have been trying to achieve through other means

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: for decades, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: They've been trying to undermine these things

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: without invasion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And they've been doing that

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: because it threatens their interests.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And that's like one of these other logics of war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: It's that there are people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: that you wanna talk about in Russia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: But they are, they don't bear all the costs of war,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: obviously, and so they're more, they're quick to use it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: But more importantly, like, in some sense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And so that's extremely important, I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And so that's, those two things in concert

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: make this a very fragile situation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: That's I think why we ended up,

body.input: But fundamentally, I think he just saw his regime

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: as threatened, that's what he cares about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And so he asked, he made this cruel list of demands.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: is destroying the thing that I value most about humanity.

body.input: to celebrate themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and the silencing of voices in the scientific community,

body.input: the silencing of voices, period.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Fuck any leader that silences that human spirit.

body.input: that feels like how progress is made,

body.input: We've basically said, you can just do really, really,

body.input: really horrible things in this region

body.input: And that's happening in a lot of places.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: In the middle of it, I didn't understand that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I don't think a lot of people did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I think I could persuade most people who study or work there now to like see it that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I think people that would make sense to people, but it didn't make sense in the moment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And you know, in the moment this is happening, it's terrible and you kind of, you know, you

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: don't realize how avoidable it was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Basically it was the absence of effective police actions that kept the lunatic from

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: being contained.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And that lunatic would never, you know, he's not that skillful of our movement, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: It could have been shut down and there was just never any political will to shut it down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: The opposite.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: That's what I meant, like that unchecked leader, not only do you not bear the cost, but you

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: might have a private incentive as an autocrat to like see that violence happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And in this case, it was just keeping a troublesome part of the country busy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: If it's okay to look at a few other wars, so we talked about drug wars in Medellin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Are there other wars that stand out to you as full of lessons?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: We can jump around a little bit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Maybe if we can return briefly at World War II from your framework, could World War II

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: have been avoided?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: This is one of the most traumatic wars, global wars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I mean, one obvious driver of that war was the things that Hitler valued and then was

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: able to use his autocratic power to either convince other people or to suppress them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And so some people stop there and say that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And then of course, because they were such an economic and political powerhouse, they

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: were able to sort of make demands of the rest of Europe that you can kind of see the full

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: – letting Nazis march into Denmark without a fight or France folding very quickly, you

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: can kind of see as like an appeasement or an acknowledgement of their superiority and

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: their ability to bargain without much of a fight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And then you can see the Western response as a principled stand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I think that's – and there's a lot of truth to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: In terms of the strategic forces, a lot of political scientists see a version of a commitment

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: problem basically where Germany says, you know what, we're strong now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: We're temporarily strong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: We're not going to be this strong forever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: If we can get this terrible bargain and get everyone to capitulate through violence, if

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: we strike now and then solidify our power and keep these – in World War I, it was

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: prevent the rise of Russia and prevent the strengthening of Russian alliances as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And so we have an incentive to strike now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And there's a window of opportunity that's closing and that they thought was closing

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: as soon as 1917 in World War I.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I don't know that that story is as persuasive in World War II.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I think there was an element of a closing window.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: They kept talking about a closing window.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: They really thought there was a closing window.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I think it was the nature of that window is different in that there was a kind of pacifism

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and it seems like if war broke out, most nations in the vicinity would not be ready.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: By the people, the leaders that are in power, they weren't ready, so the timing is really

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I wonder how often that is the case with leaders in war that feels like the timing is now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: The other commitment problem, the other shift that was happening that he wanted to avert

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: that is kind of wrapped up with his ideology is this idea of a cultural and a demographic

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: window of opportunity that if he wanted – conditional on having these views of Germanic people

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and a pure race, he had to strike now before any opportunity to establish that was possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I think that's one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: It's an incentive that requires his ideology as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: How do you avoid it within this framework?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Would you say is there – you kind of provided an explanation, but is there a way to avoid

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Is there a balance, the way to avoid it, because people kind of tried rational, peaceful kind

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: of usual negotiation and that led to this war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Is that unique to this particular war?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Let's say World War I or World War II.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: So there's an extra pressure from Germany on both wars to act.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: So we've highlighted that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Is there a way to alleviate that extra pressure to act?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Let me use World War I as an example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Those – as many German generals said at that time, we have a window of opportunity

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: before Russia where we might not win a war with Russia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: So the probability that we can win a war is going to change a lot in the next decade or

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: two, maybe even in the next few years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: So if we – we are in a much better bargaining position now, both to not use violence, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: to if necessarily use violence, because otherwise Russia is going to be extremely powerful in

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: the future and they'll be able to use that power to change the bargaining with us and

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: to like hold – keep us down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And the thing is, is in principle, Russia could say, look, we don't want to get invaded

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: We know you could invade us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: We know we're weak.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: We know we'll be strong in the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: We promise to like not wield our and abuse our or just merely just sort of take what

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: we can get in the future when we're strong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: We're going to restrain ourselves in future or we're going to hand over something that

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: makes us powerful because that's the bargain that would make us all better off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And the reason political economists call it a commitment problem is because that's a commitment

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: that would solve the problem and they can't make that commitment because there's nobody

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: who will hold them accountable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: So anything, any international legal architecture, any set of enforceable agreements, any UN Security

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Council, any world government, anything that would help you make that commitment is a solution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: All right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: If that's the core problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And so that's why, you know, in Medellin, you know, the La Fusina can do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: They can say, listen, yes, combo that's strong today is going to be weak tomorrow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: You have an incentive to eliminate this combo over here, but because they're going to be

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: strong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: But guess what?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And we're going to make sure we're going to promise that when these guys do get strong,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: we're going to restrain what they can do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I mean, most of our constitutions in most stable countries have done precisely that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: There's a lot of complaining right now in the United States about the way that the Constitution

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: is a portion power between states.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: That was a deal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: That was a commitment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: The Constitution was in the United States was a deal made to a bunch of states that

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: knew they were going to be weak in future because of economic and demographic trends

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: or guess they might be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And it said, listen, you cooperate and will commit not to basically ignore your interests

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: over the long run.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And now, you know, 250 years later, we're still honoring those commitments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: It was part of the deal that meant that there actually would be a union.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And so we do this all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: So a constitution is a good example of how every country's constitution, especially a

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: country who's writing a constitution after a war, that constitution and all of the other

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: institutions are building are an attempt to like provide commitment to groups who are

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: worried about future shifts in power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And then does that help with avoid civil war?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: So could you speak to lessons you learned from civil wars, perhaps the American Civil

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: War and the others?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: So Lebanon, one of the ways Lebanon had tried for a long time to preserve the interests

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: of minority groups, powerful minority groups who were powerful at the time and knew that

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: the demographics were working against them, was to guarantee, you know, this ethnic religious

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: group gets the presidency and this ethnic religious group gets the prime ministership

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: and this ethnic, and a lot of countries will apportion seats in the parliament to ethno-religious

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: groups.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And that's an attempt to like give a group that's temporarily powerful some assurances

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: that when they're weak in the future, that they'll still have a say, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Just like we portioned seats in the Senate in a way that's not demographically representative,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: but is like unequal, quote unquote, in a sense to help people be confident that there won't

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: be a tyranny of the majority.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And now that just happens to have been like a really unstable arrangement in Lebanon because

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: eventually like the de facto power on the ground just gets so out of line with this

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: really rigid system of the presidency goes to this ethnic religious group and this prime

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: ministership goes, that it didn't last, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: But you can think of every post-conflict agreement and every constitution is like a little bit

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: of humans' best effort to find an agreement that's going to protect the interests of a

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: group that's temporarily has an interest in violence in order to not be violent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And so there's a lot of ingenuity and it doesn't always work, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Which actually from a perspective of the group, threatening violence or actually doing violence

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: is one way to make progress for your group.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: We're talking about groups bargaining over stuff, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: We're talking about Russians versus Ukraine or Russians versus in the West, or maybe it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Medellin gangs versus one another.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Like a lot of their bargaining power comes from their ability to burn the house down,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: So if I want to have more bargaining power, I can just arm a lot and I can threaten violence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And so the strategically wise thing to do, I mean, it's terrible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: It's a terrible equilibrium for us to be forced into, but the strategically wise thing to

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: do is to build up lots of arms, to threaten to use them, to credibly threaten to use them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: but then trust or hope that like your enemy is going to see reason and avoid this really

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: terrible inefficient thing, which is fighting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: The thing that's going on the whole time is both of you arming and spending like 20% of

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: GDP or whatever on arms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: That's pretty inefficient.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: That's the tragedy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: We don't have war and that's good, but we have really limited abilities to like incentivize

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: our enemies not to arm and to keep ourselves from arming.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: We'd love to agree to just like both disarm, but we can't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And so the mess is that we have to arm and then we have to threaten all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Yeah, so the threat of violence is costly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Nevertheless, you've actually pulled up that now disappeared a paper that said the big

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: title called civil war and your name is on it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: What's that about?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Well, that was, I mean, when I was finishing graduate school and this was a paper with

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: my advisor at Ted Miguel at Berkeley.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Most nations, the paper opens, have experienced an internal armed conflict since 1960.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: But while that were you still in God's school on this or no?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Maybe last year or just graduated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I wish I was in a discipline that wrote papers like this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: This is pretty bad ass.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: Yet while civil war is central to many nations development, it has stood at the periphery

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: of economic research and teaching so on and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And this is looking at civil war broadly throughout history or is it just particular civil wars?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: We were mostly looking at like the late 20th century.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: I mean, I was trained as a what's called development economist, which is somebody who studies why

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: some places are poor and why some countries are rich.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273

body.input: And I like a number of people around that time stumbled into violence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Blattman: War and Violence | Lex Fridman Podcast #273
